title.zh: 卷九十九 志第五十二 禮二
title.raw: 卷九十九 志第五十二 禮二 Volume 99 Treatises 52: Rites 2

sentences.zh: 南郊壇制。

translations.literal: Regulations for the Southern Suburban Altar.
translations.idiomatic: Regulations for the Southern Suburban Altar.

sentences.zh: 梁及後唐郊壇皆在洛陽。

translations.literal: Under the Liang and Later Tang, suburban altars were all at Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Liang and Later Tang dynasties, the suburban altars were all located at Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 宋初始作壇于東都南薰門外，四成、十二陛、三壝。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Song an altar was first built outside the Southern Xun Gate of the Eastern Capital, with four tiers, twelve stairways, and three enclosures.
translations.idiomatic: When the Song dynasty was first established, an altar was built outside the Southern Xun Gate of the Eastern Capital, with four tiers, twelve stairways, and three concentric enclosures.

sentences.zh: 設燎壇於內壇之外丙地，高一丈二尺。

translations.literal: A fire altar was set up in the bing position outside the inner altar, twelve chi in height.
translations.idiomatic: A fire altar for burning offerings was placed in the bing (south) sector outside the inner altar, twelve chi high.

sentences.zh: 設皇帝更衣大次於東壝東門之內道北，南向。

translations.literal: The emperor's great changing pavilion was set up on the north side of the inner road inside the east gate of the eastern enclosure, facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's great pavilion for changing robes was erected on the north side of the inner road inside the east gate of the eastern enclosure, facing south.

sentences.zh: 仁宗天聖六年，始築外壝，周以短垣，置靈星門。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Tiansheng under Emperor Renzong, the outer enclosure was first built, encircled with a low wall, and a Lingxing Gate was installed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of the Tiansheng era under Emperor Renzong, the outer enclosure was first constructed, ringed with a low wall, and a Lingxing Gate was added.

sentences.zh: 親郊則立表於青城，表三壝。

translations.literal: When the emperor personally performed the suburban sacrifice, markers were set up at the Azure City, marking the three enclosures.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor performed the suburban sacrifice in person, boundary markers were erected at the Azure City to delineate the three enclosures.

sentences.zh: 神宗熙寧七年，詔中書、門下參定青城殿宇門名。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Xining under Emperor Shenzong, an edict ordered the Secretariat and Chancellery to deliberate and fix the names of the halls and gates of the Azure City.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of the Xining era under Emperor Shenzong, an edict directed the Secretariat and Chancellery to determine the official names of the halls and gates of the Azure City.

sentences.zh: 先是，每郊撰進，至是始定名，前門曰泰禋，東偏門曰迎禧，正東門曰祥曦，正西門曰景曜，後三門曰拱極，內東側門曰夤明，西側門曰肅成，殿曰端誠，殿前東、西門曰左右嘉德，便殿曰熙成，後園門曰寶華，著為定式。

translations.literal: Previously, at each suburban sacrifice names were drafted and submitted; only now were they fixed: the front gate was called Taichin, the east side gate Yingxi, the main east gate Xiangxi, the main west gate Jingyao, the three rear gates Gongji, the inner east side gate Yinming, the west side gate Sucheng, the hall Duancheng, the east and west gates before the hall Left and Right Jiade, the side hall Xicheng, the rear garden gate Baohua — established as the fixed pattern.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, new names had been drafted and submitted at each suburban sacrifice; only now were they fixed for good. The front gate was named Taichin (“Supreme Offering”), the east side gate Yingxi (“Welcoming Blessings”), the main east gate Xiangxi (“Auspicious Dawn”), the main west gate Jingyao (“Radiant Splendor”), the three rear gates Gongji (“Arched Pole”), the inner east side gate Yinming (“Dawn Brightness”), the west side gate Sucheng (“Solemn Completion”), the main hall Duancheng (“Upright Sincerity”), the east and west gates before the hall Left and Right Jiade (“Fine Virtue”), the side hall Xicheng (“Radiant Completion”), and the rear garden gate Baohua (“Treasured Splendor”) — all established as the permanent standard.

sentences.zh: 元豐元年二月，詔內壝之外，眾星位周環，每二步植一杙，繚以青繩，以為限域。

translations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Yuanfeng, an edict ordered that outside the inner enclosure, around the positions of the host of stars, a stake be planted every two paces and wound with blue cord to serve as the boundary.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the first year of Yuanfeng, an edict directed that outside the inner enclosure, around the circuit of star positions, a stake be planted every two paces and strung with blue cord to mark the boundary zone.

sentences.zh: 既而詳定奉祀禮文所言：「《周官》外祀皆有兆域，後世因之，稍增其制。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Detailed Regulations for Sacrificial Rites stated: "In the Offices of Zhou, outer sacrifices all had demarcated precincts; later ages followed this and gradually enlarged the institution.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the office that had detailed the ritual texts for suburban sacrifice reported: "According to the Offices of Zhou, all outer sacrifices had demarcated precincts; later ages followed this practice and gradually expanded the regulations.

sentences.zh: 國朝郊壇率循唐舊，雖儀注具載圜丘三壝，每壝二十五步，而有司乃以青繩代內壝，誠不足以等神位、序祀事、嚴內外之限也。

translations.literal: Our dynasty's suburban altars generally followed Tang practice; although the ritual manuals fully record three enclosures for the Circular Mound, each enclosure twenty-five paces, the responsible officials used blue cord in place of the inner enclosure — truly insufficient to rank the spirit positions, order the sacrificial proceedings, and enforce the distinction between inner and outer.
translations.idiomatic: Our dynasty's suburban altars generally followed Tang precedent. Although the ritual manuals fully specify three enclosures for the Circular Mound, each twenty-five paces wide, the responsible officials had used blue cord in place of a proper inner enclosure — which was truly inadequate to rank the spirit positions, order the sequence of sacrifice, and enforce the distinction between inner and outer precincts.

sentences.zh: 伏請除去青繩，為三壝之制。」

translations.literal: We respectfully request that the blue cord be removed and the three-enclosure system instituted."
translations.idiomatic: We respectfully request that the blue cord be removed and the three-enclosure system be instituted in its place."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the request.

sentences.zh: 徽宗政和三年，詔有司討論壇壝之制。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhenghe under Emperor Huizong, an edict ordered the responsible offices to deliberate on the regulations for altar mounds and enclosures.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of the Zhenghe era under Emperor Huizong, an edict directed the responsible offices to deliberate on the regulations governing altar mounds and their enclosures.

sentences.zh: 十月，禮制局言：「壇舊制四成，一成二十丈，再成十五丈，三成十丈，四成五丈，成高八尺一寸；

translations.literal: In the tenth month the Ritual Regulations Bureau stated: "The old altar regulation had four tiers: the first tier twenty zhang, the second fifteen zhang, the third ten zhang, the fourth five zhang, each tier eight chi and one cun in height;
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the Ritual Regulations Bureau reported: "Under the old altar regulations there were four tiers: the first tier twenty zhang wide, the second fifteen zhang, the third ten zhang, the fourth five zhang, each tier eight chi and one cun high;

sentences.zh: 十有二陛，陛十有二級；

translations.literal: there were twelve stairways, each stairway with twelve steps;
translations.idiomatic: there were twelve stairways, each with twelve steps;

sentences.zh: 三壝，二十五步。

translations.literal: and three enclosures, each twenty-five paces.
translations.idiomatic: and three enclosures, each twenty-five paces wide.

sentences.zh: 古所謂地上圜丘、澤中方丘，皆因地形之自然。

translations.literal: What antiquity called the round mound on high ground and the square mound in a marsh all followed the natural terrain.
translations.idiomatic: What antiquity called the round mound on elevated ground and the square mound in a marshy flat all followed the natural lay of the land.

sentences.zh: 王者建國，或無自然之丘，則于郊澤吉土以兆壇位。

translations.literal: When a king founded his state, if there was no natural mound, he chose auspicious soil in the suburban marsh to mark out the altar site.
translations.idiomatic: When a ruler founded his state, if no natural mound was available, he selected auspicious soil in the suburban marshlands to mark out the altar precinct.

sentences.zh: 為壇之制，當用陽數，今定為壇三成，一成用九九之數，廣八十一丈，再成用六九之數，廣五十四丈，三成用三九之數，廣二十七丈。

translations.literal: The regulation for building an altar should employ yang numbers; it is now fixed as three tiers: the first tier using the product of nine and nine, eighty-one zhang in breadth; the second using six times nine, fifty-four zhang; the third using three times nine, twenty-seven zhang.
translations.idiomatic: The regulations for constructing an altar should employ yang numbers. It is now fixed at three tiers: the first tier uses nine times nine, eighty-one zhang in breadth; the second uses six times nine, fifty-four zhang; the third uses three times nine, twenty-seven zhang.

sentences.zh: 每成高二十七尺，三成總二百七十有六，《乾》之策也。

translations.literal: Each tier is twenty-seven chi in height; the three tiers total two hundred seventy-six — the tally of the Qian hexagram.
translations.idiomatic: Each tier is twenty-seven chi high; the three tiers together total two hundred seventy-six chi — the number of tally sticks in the Qian hexagram.

sentences.zh: 為三壝，壝三十六步，亦《乾》之策也。

translations.literal: There are three enclosures, each thirty-six paces — also the tally of Qian.
translations.idiomatic: There are three enclosures, each thirty-six paces wide — likewise derived from the tally of the Qian hexagram.

sentences.zh: 成與壝地之數也。」

translations.literal: These are the numbers for the tiers and the enclosures on the ground."
translations.idiomatic: These are the numbers governing the tiers and the enclosures on the ground."

sentences.zh: 詔行之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered this put into practice.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered these regulations implemented.

sentences.zh: 建炎二年，高宗至揚州，庶事草創，築壇于州南門內江都縣之東南，詔東京所屬官吏奉祭器、大樂、儀仗、法物赴行在所。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jianyan, when Emperor Gaozong reached Yangzhou, all affairs were still being improvised; an altar was built southeast of Jiangdu County inside the south gate of the prefecture, and an edict ordered officials subordinate to the Eastern Capital to convey sacrificial vessels, great music, ceremonial regalia, and ritual implements to the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jianyan, when Emperor Gaozong reached Yangzhou, affairs were still being improvised from scratch. An altar was built southeast of Jiangdu County inside the prefecture's south gate, and an edict ordered officials of the former Eastern Capital to bring sacrificial vessels, court music, ceremonial regalia, and ritual implements to the mobile court.

sentences.zh: 紹興十三年，太常寺言：「國朝圓壇在國之東南，壇側建青城齋宮，以備郊宿。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Shaoxing, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices stated: "Our dynasty's Circular Mound is in the southeast of the capital; beside the mound the Azure City fasting palace was built to provide lodging for the suburban vigil.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Shaoxing, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported: "Our dynasty's Circular Mound lies in the southeast of the capital, and beside it an Azure City fasting palace was built to lodge the emperor during the suburban vigil.

sentences.zh: 今宜於臨安府行宮東南修建。」

translations.literal: It is now fitting to build it southeast of the temporary palace at Lin'an Prefecture."
translations.idiomatic: It is now appropriate to construct one southeast of the temporary palace at Lin'an Prefecture."

sentences.zh: 於是，遂詔臨安府及殿前司修建圓壇，第一成縱廣七丈，第二成縱廣一十二丈，第三成縱廣一十七丈，第四成縱廣二十二丈。

translations.literal: Thereupon an edict ordered Lin'an Prefecture and the Palace Front Command to build the Circular Mound: the first tier seven zhang in length and breadth, the second twelve zhang, the third seventeen zhang, the fourth twenty-two zhang.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon an edict ordered Lin'an Prefecture and the Palace Front Command to construct the Circular Mound: the first tier seven zhang square, the second twelve zhang, the third seventeen zhang, and the fourth twenty-two zhang.

sentences.zh: 一十二陛，每陛七十二級，每成一十二綴。

translations.literal: There were twelve stairways, each stairway with seventy-two steps, twelve steps on each tier.
translations.idiomatic: There were twelve stairways, each with seventy-two steps, twelve steps per tier.

sentences.zh: 三壝，第一壝去壇二十五步，中壝去內壝、外壝去中壝各半之。

translations.literal: Three enclosures: the first enclosure twenty-five paces from the mound; the middle enclosure half that distance from the inner, and the outer half that from the middle.
translations.idiomatic: There were three enclosures: the inner enclosure stood twenty-five paces from the mound; the middle enclosure was half that distance from the inner, and the outer half that distance from the middle.

sentences.zh: 燎壇方一丈，高一丈二尺，開上南出戶，方六尺，三出陛，在壇南二十步丙地。

translations.literal: The fire altar was one zhang square and one zhang two chi high, with an opening on top and a door opening to the south six chi square, three stairways on each side, placed twenty paces south of the mound in the bing position.
translations.idiomatic: The fire altar was one zhang square and one zhang two chi high, with an opening on top and a south-facing door six chi square, three stairways on each side, placed twenty paces south of the mound in the bing (south) sector.

sentences.zh: 其青城及望祭殿與行事陪祠官宿齋幕次，並令絞縛，更不修蓋。

translations.literal: The Azure City, the Hall of Gazing Sacrifice, and the fasting tents where officiating and attendant sacrifice officials lodged were all ordered lashed together with rope and not given permanent roofing.
translations.idiomatic: The Azure City, the Hall of Gazing Sacrifice, and the fasting tents where officiating and attendant officials lodged were all to be lashed together with rope frames and were not to receive permanent roofing.

sentences.zh: 先是，張杓為京尹，議築齋宮，可一勞永逸，宇文價曰：「陛下方經略河南，今築青城，是無中原也。」

translations.literal: Earlier, when Zhang Biao was metropolitan magistrate, he proposed building a fasting palace that would be a single effort for lasting benefit; Yuwen Jia said: "Your Majesty is just now planning recovery of the lands south of the Yellow River; to build the Azure City now is to declare that the Central Plains are lost."
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Zhang Biao served as metropolitan magistrate, he proposed building a permanent fasting palace as a one-time effort for lasting benefit. Yuwen Jia objected: "Your Majesty is still planning to recover the Central Plains; to build a permanent Azure City now would be to concede that the heartland is lost forever."

sentences.zh: 遂罷役。

translations.literal: The work was then halted.
translations.idiomatic: The construction was then halted.

sentences.zh: 神位。

translations.literal: Spirit Positions.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit Positions.

sentences.zh: 元豐元年十一月，詳定郊廟奉祀禮文所言：「按東漢壇位，天神從祀者至千五百一十四，故外設重營，以為等限。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the first year of Yuanfeng, the Detailed Regulations for Suburban and Temple Sacrifice stated: "According to the Eastern Han altar layout, attendant worship of heavenly spirits reached one thousand five hundred fourteen, hence outer encampments were set up as graded boundaries.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the first year of Yuanfeng, the office that had detailed the ritual texts for suburban and temple sacrifice reported: "According to the Eastern Han altar layout, spirits of heaven receiving attendant sacrifice numbered as many as one thousand five hundred and fourteen; therefore outer encampments were established as graded boundaries.

sentences.zh: 日月在中營內南道，而北斗在北道之西，至於五星中宮宿之屬，則其位皆中營，二十八宿外宮星之屬，則其位皆外營。

translations.literal: The sun and moon were on the southern path within the middle encampment, while the Northern Dipper was west of the northern path; as for the Five Stars and stars of the inner palaces, their positions were all in the middle encampment, while the Twenty-eight Lunar Mansions and stars of the outer palaces were all in the outer encampment.
translations.idiomatic: The sun and moon stood on the southern path within the middle encampment, while the Northern Dipper lay west of the northern path. The Five Stars and stars of the inner palaces were all placed in the middle encampment, whereas the Twenty-eight Lunar Mansions and stars of the outer palaces were all placed in the outer encampment.

sentences.zh: 然則為重營者，所以等神位也。

translations.literal: Thus multiple encampments served to rank the spirit positions.
translations.idiomatic: Multiple encampments, then, served to rank the spirit positions.

sentences.zh: 唐因隋制，設為三壝，天神列位不出內壝，而御位特設於壇下之東南。

translations.literal: Tang followed Sui practice, establishing three enclosures; the ranked positions of heavenly spirits did not extend beyond the inner enclosure, while the imperial position was specially set southeast below the mound.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang followed Sui practice and established three enclosures: the ranked positions of heavenly spirits did not extend beyond the inner enclosure, while the imperial position was specially placed southeast below the mound.

sentences.zh: 若夫公卿分獻、文武從祀，與夫樂架饌幔，則皆在中壝之內，而大次之設乃在外壝。

translations.literal: As for the separate offerings of dukes and ministers, the attendant worship of civil and military officials, and the music stands and food curtains, all were within the middle enclosure, while the great pavilions were set in the outer enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: The separate offerings of dukes and ministers, the attendant worship of civil and military officials, and the music stands and food curtains were all placed within the middle enclosure, while the great pavilions were set up in the outer enclosure.

sentences.zh: 然則為三壝者，所以序祀事也。」

translations.literal: Thus three enclosures served to order the sacrificial proceedings."
translations.idiomatic: Three enclosures, then, served to order the sequence of sacrificial proceedings."

sentences.zh: 景德三年，鹵簿使王欽若言：「漢以五帝為天神之佐，今在第一龕；

translations.literal: In the third year of Jingde, Wang Qinruo, commissioner of the imperial guard of honor, stated: "Han took the Five Emperors as assistants to the Spirit of Heaven; they are now in the first niche;
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jingde, Wang Qinruo, commissioner of the imperial guard of honor, reported: "The Han regarded the Five Emperors as assistants to the Spirit of Heaven, yet they are now placed in the first niche;

sentences.zh: 天皇大帝在第二龕，與六甲、嶽瀆之類接席；

translations.literal: the Great Heavenly Emperor is in the second niche, sharing mats with the Six Jia, mountains and rivers, and the like;
translations.idiomatic: the Great Heavenly Emperor is in the second niche, seated alongside the Six Jia spirits, mountains and rivers, and the like;

sentences.zh: 帝座，天市之尊，今與二十八宿、積薪、騰蛇、杵臼之類同在第三龕。

translations.literal: the Imperial Seat, lord of the Heavenly Market, is now in the third niche together with the Twenty-eight Mansions, Piled Firewood, Soaring Serpent, Pestle and Mortar, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: the Imperial Seat, sovereign of the Heavenly Market Enclosure, is now grouped in the third niche with the Twenty-eight Mansions, Piled Firewood, Soaring Serpent, Pestle and Mortar, and the like.

sentences.zh: 卑主尊臣，甚未便也。

translations.literal: A lowly lord and exalted ministers — this is very improper.
translations.idiomatic: To place the exalted below and the humble above is most improper.

sentences.zh: 若以北極、帝坐本非天帝，蓋是天帝所居，則北極在第二，帝坐在第三，亦高下未等。

translations.literal: If the Northern Pole and Imperial Seat are not the Heavenly Thearch in themselves but merely where the Heavenly Thearch dwells, then the Northern Pole in the second and the Imperial Seat in the third are also unequal in rank.
translations.idiomatic: If the Northern Pole and Imperial Seat are not the Heavenly Thearch himself but merely the places where he dwells, then placing the Northern Pole in the second niche and the Imperial Seat in the third is likewise a mismatch in rank.

sentences.zh: 又太微之次少左右執法，子星之次少孫星，望令司天監參驗。」

translations.literal: Moreover, the Taiwei sequence lacks the Left and Right Law-Enforcers, and the Zi Star sequence lacks the Grandson Star; we request that the Directorate of Astronomy investigate."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the Taiwei sequence lacks the Left and Right Law-Enforcers, and the Zi Star sequence lacks the Grandson Star. We request that the Directorate of Astronomy investigate and verify."

sentences.zh: 乃詔禮儀使、太常禮院、司天監檢定之。

translations.literal: An edict then ordered the commissioner of ritual, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices ritual office, and the Directorate of Astronomy to examine and fix the matter.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then ordered the commissioner of ritual, the ritual office of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and the Directorate of Astronomy to examine the matter and determine the correct arrangement.

sentences.zh: 禮儀使趙安仁言：「按《開寶通禮》，元氣廣大則稱昊天，據遠視之蒼然，則稱蒼天。

translations.literal: The ritual commissioner Zhao Anren stated: "According to the Comprehensive Rites of Kaibao, when primordial qi is vast it is called Haotian; viewed from afar in its azure expanse, it is called Cangtian.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual commissioner Zhao Anren reported: "According to the Comprehensive Rites of Kaibao, when primordial qi is vast and all-encompassing it is called Haotian (Vast Heaven); viewed from afar in its azure expanse, it is called Cangtian (Azure Heaven).

sentences.zh: 人之所尊，莫過於帝，托之於天，故稱上帝。

translations.literal: What humans revere most is the Thearch; entrusting this to Heaven, it is therefore called Shangdi.
translations.idiomatic: What humans revere above all is the Thearch; entrusting this supreme dignity to Heaven, it is therefore called Shangdi (Supreme Thearch).

sentences.zh: 天皇大帝即北辰耀魄寶也，自是星中之尊。

translations.literal: The Great Heavenly Thearch is the North Star Yaopobao — by nature the most exalted among stars.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Heavenly Thearch is the North Star Yaopobao — by nature the most exalted among the stars.

sentences.zh: 《易》曰：'日月麗乎天，百穀草木麗乎土。

translations.literal: The Changes says: 'The sun and moon are attached to heaven; the hundred grains and plants are attached to earth.
translations.idiomatic: The Book of Changes says: 'The sun and moon cling to heaven; the hundred grains and plants cling to earth.

sentences.zh: '又曰：'在天成象，在地成形。

translations.literal: It also says: in heaven images are formed; on earth forms take shape.
translations.idiomatic: It also says: in heaven images take form; on earth bodies take shape.

sentences.zh: '蓋明辰象非天，草木非地，是則天以蒼昊為體，不入星辰之列。

translations.literal: This makes clear that stellar images are not heaven and plants are not earth; thus heaven takes azure vastness as its substance and does not enter the ranks of stars.
translations.idiomatic: This makes clear that stellar images are not heaven itself and plants are not earth itself; heaven takes azure vastness as its substance and does not belong among the stars.

sentences.zh: 又《郊祀錄》：'壇第二等祀天皇大帝、北斗、天一、太一、紫微、五帝坐，差在行位前，餘內官諸位及五星、十二辰、河漢，都四十九坐齊列，俱在十二陛之間。

translations.literal: The Record of Suburban Sacrifice also states: 'The second rank on the altar worships the Great Heavenly Thearch, the Northern Dipper, Tianyi, Taiyi, Ziwei, and the Seats of the Five Emperors, slightly before the procession positions; the remaining inner-palace positions together with the Five Stars, Twelve Branches, and River of Han — forty-nine seats in all, aligned in a row between the twelve stairways.
translations.idiomatic: The Record of Suburban Sacrifice also states: 'The second rank on the altar worships the Great Heavenly Thearch, the Northern Dipper, Tianyi, Taiyi, Ziwei, and the Seats of the Five Emperors, placed slightly ahead of the procession positions; the remaining inner-palace positions together with the Five Stars, Twelve Branches, and River of Han — forty-nine seats in all, aligned in a row between the twelve stairways.

sentences.zh: ' 唐建中間，司天冬官正郭獻之奏：'天皇、北極、天一、太一，准《天寶敕》併合升第一等。

translations.literal: ' In the Jianzhong period of Tang, Guo Xianzhi, director of the winter office of the Directorate of Astronomy, memorialized: 'The Great Heavenly Thearch, Northern Pole, Tianyi, and Taiyi — pursuant to the Tianbao edict — should all be promoted together to the first rank.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jianzhong period of Tang, Guo Xianzhi, director of the winter office of the Directorate of Astronomy, memorialized that the Great Heavenly Thearch, Northern Pole, Tianyi, and Taiyi should all be promoted together to the first rank, pursuant to the Tianbao edict.

sentences.zh: '貞元二年親郊，乙太常議，詔復從《開元禮》，仍為定制。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhenyuan, when the emperor personally performed the suburban sacrifice, following the Court of Imperial Sacrifices' deliberation, an edict restored compliance with the Kaiyuan Rites, and this remained the fixed regulation.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhenyuan, when the emperor performed the suburban sacrifice in person, following the Court of Imperial Sacrifices' deliberation, an edict restored compliance with the Kaiyuan Rites, and this remained the fixed regulation.

sentences.zh: 《郊祀錄》又云：'壇第三等有中宮、天市垣、帝坐等十七坐，並在前。

translations.literal: The Record of Suburban Sacrifice also states: 'The third rank on the altar has the Central Palace, Heavenly Market Enclosure, Imperial Seat, and seventeen seats in all, all placed forward.
translations.idiomatic: The Record of Suburban Sacrifice also states: 'The third rank on the altar includes the Central Palace, Heavenly Market Enclosure, Imperial Seat, and seventeen seats in all, all placed in the forward positions.

sentences.zh: '《開元禮義羅》云：'帝有五坐，一在紫微宮，一在大角，一在太微宮，一在心，一在天市垣。

translations.literal: The Exegesis of the Kaiyuan Rites states that there are five Imperial Seats: one in the Purple Forbidden Palace, one at Great Horn, one in the Supreme Palace Enclosure, one at Heart, and one in the Heavenly Market Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: The Exegesis of the Kaiyuan Rites states that there are five Imperial Seats: one in the Purple Forbidden Palace, one at Great Horn, one in the Supreme Palace Enclosure, one at Heart, and one in the Heavenly Market Enclosure.

sentences.zh: '即帝坐者非直指天帝也。

translations.literal: Thus the Imperial Seat does not directly refer to the Heavenly Thearch.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the Imperial Seat does not refer directly to the Heavenly Thearch himself.

sentences.zh: 又得判司天監史序狀：'天皇大帝一星在紫微勾陳中，其神曰耀魄寶，即天皇是星，五帝乃天帝也。

translations.literal: We also obtained the affidavit of Shi Xu, acting director of the Directorate of Astronomy: 'The single star of the Great Heavenly Thearch is within the Purple Forbidden Gouchen; its spirit is called Yaopobao — the Great Heavenly Thearch is a star; the Five Emperors are the Heavenly Thearch.
translations.idiomatic: We also obtained the affidavit of Shi Xu, acting director of the Directorate of Astronomy: 'The star of the Great Heavenly Thearch lies within the Purple Forbidden Gouchen; its spirit is called Yaopobao — the Great Heavenly Thearch is a star, whereas the Five Emperors represent the Heavenly Thearch.

sentences.zh: 北極五星在紫微垣內，居中一星曰北辰，第一主月為太子，第二主日為帝王，第三為庶子，第四為嫡子，第五為天子之樞，蓋北辰所主非一，又非帝坐之比。

translations.literal: The five stars of the Northern Pole are within the Purple Forbidden Enclosure; the central star is called North Star — the first governs the moon as crown prince, the second governs the sun as emperor, the third is for the secondary son, the fourth for the legitimate son, the fifth for the pivot of the Son of Heaven; thus what the North Star governs is not single, and it is not comparable to the Imperial Seat.
translations.idiomatic: The five stars of the Northern Pole lie within the Purple Forbidden Enclosure; the central star is called the North Star — the first governs the moon as crown prince, the second governs the sun as emperor, the third represents the secondary son, the fourth the legitimate son, and the fifth the pivot of the Son of Heaven. What the North Star governs is manifold, and it is not comparable to the Imperial Seat.

sentences.zh: 太微垣十星有左右執法、上將、次將之名，不可備陳，故總名太微垣。

translations.literal: The ten stars of the Supreme Palace Enclosure bear the names Left and Right Law-Enforcer, Senior General, and Junior General — they cannot all be enumerated, hence they are collectively called the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: The ten stars of the Supreme Palace Enclosure bear names such as Left and Right Law-Enforcer, Senior General, and Junior General — they cannot all be enumerated individually, and are therefore collectively called the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 《星經》舊載孫星，而《壇圖》止有子星，辨其尊卑，不可同位。

translations.literal: The Classic of Stars formerly records the Grandson Star, while the Altar Diagram has only the Son Star; distinguishing their relative rank, they cannot share a position.
translations.idiomatic: The Classic of Stars formerly records the Grandson Star, while the Altar Diagram lists only the Son Star; given their difference in rank, they cannot share the same position.

sentences.zh: '竊惟《壇圖》舊制，悉有明據，天神定位，難以躋升，望依《星經》，悉以舊禮為定。」

translations.literal: We venture to consider that the old regulations of the Altar Diagram all have clear warrant; the positioning of heavenly spirits is difficult to promote; we hope that in accordance with the Classic of Stars, the old rites may all be taken as fixed."
translations.idiomatic: We venture to consider that the old regulations of the Altar Diagram all rest on clear authority; the positioning of heavenly spirits is difficult to alter by promotion. We hope that in accordance with the Classic of Stars, the established rites may be upheld as fixed."

sentences.zh: 欽若復言：「舊史《天文志》並云：北極，北辰最尊者。

translations.literal: Qinruo again stated: "The astronomical treatises of the old histories all say: the Northern Pole — the North Star is the most exalted.
translations.idiomatic: Qinruo spoke again: "The astronomical treatises of the old histories all state that the Northern Pole — the North Star — is the most exalted.

sentences.zh: 又勾陳口中一星曰天皇大帝，鄭玄注《周禮》謂：'禮天者，冬至祭天皇於北極也。

translations.literal: Moreover, within the mouth of Gouchen there is a star called the Great Heavenly Thearch; Zheng Xuan's commentary on the Rites of Zhou states: 'Those who worship Heaven sacrifice to the Great Heavenly Thearch at the Northern Pole at the winter solstice.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, within the mouth of Gouchen there is a star called the Great Heavenly Thearch. Zheng Xuan's commentary on the Rites of Zhou states: 'Those who worship Heaven sacrifice to the Great Heavenly Thearch at the Northern Pole at the winter solstice.

sentences.zh: '後魏孝文禋六宗，亦升天皇五帝上。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaowen of Later Wei performed the yin sacrifice to the Six Ancestors and also elevated the Great Heavenly Thearch above the Five Emperors.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaowen of Northern Wei performed the yin sacrifice to the Six Ancestors and likewise elevated the Great Heavenly Thearch above the Five Emperors.

sentences.zh: 按晉《天文志》：'帝坐光而潤，則天子吉，威令行。

translations.literal: According to the Jin Astronomical Treatise: 'When the Imperial Seat is bright and lustrous, the Son of Heaven is fortunate and his commands are carried out.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Jin Astronomical Treatise: 'When the Imperial Seat is bright and lustrous, the Son of Heaven is fortunate and his commands prevail.

sentences.zh: '既名帝坐，則為天子所占，列於下位，未見其可。

translations.literal: Since it is called the Imperial Seat, it is what the Son of Heaven occupies; to place it in a lower rank — we do not see how this can be right.
translations.idiomatic: Since it is called the Imperial Seat, it is what the Son of Heaven occupies astrologically; to place it in a lower rank seems inadmissible.

sentences.zh: 又安仁議，以子、孫二星不可同位。

translations.literal: Moreover, Anren argued that the Son and Grandson Stars cannot share a position.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, Anren argued that the Son and Grandson Stars cannot share the same position.

sentences.zh: 陛下方洽高禖之慶，以廣維城之基，苟因前代闕文，便為得禮，實恐聖朝茂典，尤未適中。」

translations.literal: Your Majesty is just now enjoying the blessings of the High Mound to broaden the foundation of the realm's walls; if we take lacunae in former ages' texts as sufficient for correct ritual, we truly fear that our sage dynasty's splendid regulations will fall especially wide of the mark."
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty is just now enjoying the blessings of the High Mound sacrifice to broaden the foundations of the imperial house. If we treat lacunae in former ages' ritual texts as sufficient warrant for correct practice, we truly fear that our sage dynasty's splendid regulations will fall wide of the proper standard."

sentences.zh: 詔天皇、北極特升第一龕，又設孫星于子星位次，帝坐如故。

translations.literal: An edict specially promoted the Great Heavenly Thearch and Northern Pole to the first niche, also established the Grandson Star in the sequence after the Son Star, and left the Imperial Seat as before.
translations.idiomatic: An edict specially promoted the Great Heavenly Thearch and Northern Pole to the first niche, established the Grandson Star in sequence after the Son Star, and left the Imperial Seat as before.

sentences.zh: 欽若又言：「帝坐止三，紫微、太微者已列第二等，唯天市一坐在第三等。

translations.literal: Qinruo again stated: "There are only three Imperial Seats; those of Ziwei and Taiwei are already in the second rank — only the Heavenly Market Seat is in the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: Qinruo spoke again: "There are only three Imperial Seats; those of Ziwei and Taiwei are already in the second rank — only the Heavenly Market Seat remains in the third rank.

sentences.zh: 按《晉志》，大角及心中星但雲天王坐，實與帝坐不類。」

translations.literal: According to the Jin Treatise, Great Horn and the star at Heart are only called the Seat of the Heavenly King — they are in fact not of the same category as the Imperial Seat."
translations.idiomatic: According to the Jin Treatise, Great Horn and the star at Heart are only called the Seat of the Heavenly King — they are in fact not of the same category as the Imperial Seat."

sentences.zh: 詔特升第二龕。

translations.literal: An edict specially promoted it to the second niche.
translations.idiomatic: An edict specially promoted it to the second niche.

sentences.zh: 舊郊丘，神位板皆有司題署，命欽若改造之。

translations.literal: At the old suburban mound and hill, spirit-position tablets were all inscribed by the responsible offices; Qinruo was ordered to remake them.
translations.idiomatic: At the old suburban mound and hill, spirit-position tablets had all been inscribed by the responsible offices; Qinruo was ordered to remake them.

sentences.zh: 至是，欽若奉板便殿，壇上四位，塗以朱漆金字，余皆黑漆，第一等金字，第二等黃字，第三等以降朱字，悉貯漆匣，覆以黃縑帊。

translations.literal: At this time Qinruo presented the tablets in the side hall; the four positions on the mound were coated with vermilion lacquer and gold characters, the rest with black lacquer — first rank in gold characters, second rank in yellow characters, third rank and below in vermilion characters — all stored in lacquer cases covered with yellow silk cloth.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Qinruo presented the tablets in the side hall. The four positions on the mound were coated with vermilion lacquer and inscribed in gold, the rest in black lacquer — first rank in gold characters, second rank in yellow, third rank and below in vermilion — all stored in lacquer cases covered with yellow silk cloth.

sentences.zh: 帝降階觀之，即付有司。

translations.literal: The emperor descended the steps to view them and immediately handed them to the responsible offices.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor descended the steps to inspect them and immediately handed them over to the responsible offices.

sentences.zh: 又以新定《壇圖》，五帝、五嶽、中鎮、河漢合在第三等。

translations.literal: According to the newly fixed Altar Diagram, the Five Emperors, Five Sacred Mountains, Central Peak, and River of Han were combined in the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: According to the newly fixed Altar Diagram, the Five Emperors, Five Sacred Mountains, Central Peak, and River of Han were all grouped in the third rank.

sentences.zh: 四年，判太常禮院孫奭言：「准禮，冬至祀圜丘，有司攝事，以天神六百九十位從祀。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Sun Shi, acting head of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices ritual office, stated: "According to the rites, at the winter solstice sacrifice to the Circular Mound, when officials perform the ceremony by proxy, six hundred ninety positions of heavenly spirits receive attendant worship.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, Sun Shi, acting head of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices ritual office, reported: "According to the rites, at the winter solstice sacrifice to the Circular Mound, when officials perform the ceremony by proxy, six hundred ninety heavenly spirits receive attendant worship.

sentences.zh: 今惟有五方上帝及五人神十七位，天皇大帝以下並不設位。

translations.literal: Now there are only the Five Directional Thearchs and seventeen human spirits — from the Great Heavenly Thearch downward no positions are set up.
translations.idiomatic: At present there are only the Five Directional Thearchs and seventeen human spirits — from the Great Heavenly Thearch downward, no positions are established at all.

sentences.zh: 且太昊、勾芒，惟孟夏雩祀、季秋大享及之，今乃祀於冬至，恐未協宜。」

translations.literal: Moreover, Taihao and Goumang are reached only at the midsummer rain sacrifice and the great offering of late autumn — to worship them now at the winter solstice is perhaps not appropriate."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, Taihao and Goumang are worshipped only at the midsummer rain sacrifice and the great autumn offering — to include them in the winter solstice sacrifice is perhaps inappropriate."

sentences.zh: 翰林學士晁迥等言：「按《開寶通禮》：圜丘，有司攝事，祀昊天、配帝、五方帝、日月、五星、中官、外官、眾星總六百八十七位；

translations.literal: The Hanlin academician Chao Jiong and others stated: "According to the Comprehensive Rites of Kaibao: at the Circular Mound, when officials perform by proxy, they worship Haotian, the associated Thearch, the Five Directional Thearchs, sun and moon, Five Stars, inner-palace, outer-palace, and host of stars — six hundred eighty-seven positions in all;
translations.idiomatic: The Hanlin academician Chao Jiong and others reported: "According to the Comprehensive Rites of Kaibao: at the Circular Mound, when officials perform the ceremony by proxy, they worship Haotian, the associated Thearch, the Five Directional Thearchs, sun and moon, Five Stars, inner-palace stars, outer-palace stars, and the host of stars — six hundred eighty-seven positions in all;

sentences.zh: 雩祀、大享，昊天、配帝、五天帝、五人帝、五官總十七位；

translations.literal: at the rain sacrifice and great offering, Haotian, the associated Thearch, Five Heavenly Thearchs, Five Human Thearchs, and Five Officials — seventeen positions in all;
translations.idiomatic: at the rain sacrifice and great offering, Haotian, the associated Thearch, Five Heavenly Thearchs, Five Human Thearchs, and Five Officials — seventeen positions in all;

sentences.zh: 方丘，祭皇地祇、配帝、神州、嶽鎮、海瀆七十一位。

translations.literal: at the Square Mound, they sacrifice to the Imperial Earth Spirit, associated Thearch, Divine Land, mountains and marshes, seas and rivers — seventy-one positions.
translations.idiomatic: at the Square Mound, they sacrifice to the Imperial Earth Spirit, the associated Thearch, the Divine Land, mountains and marshes, and seas and rivers — seventy-one positions.

sentences.zh: 今司天監所設圜丘、雩祀、明堂、方丘並七十位，即是方丘有嶽、瀆從祀，圜丘無星辰，而反以人帝從祀。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Astronomy now sets up seventy positions for the Circular Mound, rain sacrifice, Bright Hall, and Square Mound alike — meaning the Square Mound has mountains and rivers in attendant worship while the Circular Mound has no stars, yet human thearchs receive attendant worship instead.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Astronomy now sets up only seventy positions for the Circular Mound, rain sacrifice, Bright Hall, and Square Mound alike — meaning the Square Mound includes mountains and rivers in attendant worship while the Circular Mound has no stars, yet human thearchs receive attendant worship instead.

sentences.zh: 望如奭請，以《通禮》及神位為定，其有增益者如後敕。」

translations.literal: We hope that, as Sun Shi requested, the Comprehensive Rites and spirit positions may be taken as fixed; any additions may follow later edicts."
translations.idiomatic: We hope that, as Sun Shi requested, the Comprehensive Rites and the established spirit positions may be taken as the standard; any additions may follow subsequent edicts."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the request.

sentences.zh: 政和三年，議禮局上《五禮新儀》：皇帝祀昊天上帝，太史設神位版，昊天上帝位於壇上北方南向，席以稿秸；

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhenghe, the Deliberations on Rites Bureau submitted the New Rituals of the Five Sacrifices: when the emperor worships Haotian Shangdi, the grand astrologer sets up spirit-position tablets; Haotian Shangdi's position is in the north of the mound facing south, with a mat of straw;
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Zhenghe, the Deliberations on Rites Bureau submitted the New Rituals of the Five Sacrifices: when the emperor worships Haotian Shangdi, the grand astrologer sets up spirit-position tablets. Haotian Shangdi's position is in the north of the mound facing south, with a mat of straw;

sentences.zh: 太祖位於壇上東方西向，席以蒲越；

translations.literal: Taizu is in the east of the mound facing west, with a mat of bulrush;
translations.idiomatic: Taizu is placed in the east of the mound facing west, with a mat of bulrush;

sentences.zh: 天皇大帝、五帝、大明、夜明、北極九位於第一龕；

translations.literal: the Great Heavenly Thearch, Five Emperors, Great Brightness, Night Brightness, and Northern Pole — nine positions in the first niche;
translations.idiomatic: the Great Heavenly Thearch, Five Emperors, Great Brightness, Night Brightness, and Northern Pole — nine positions in the first niche;

sentences.zh: 北斗、太一、帝坐、五帝內坐、五星、十二辰、河漢等內官神位五十有四於第二龕；

translations.literal: the Northern Dipper, Taiyi, Imperial Seat, inner seats of the Five Emperors, Five Stars, Twelve Branches, River of Han, and other inner-palace spirit positions — fifty-four in the second niche;
translations.idiomatic: the Northern Dipper, Taiyi, Imperial Seat, inner seats of the Five Emperors, Five Stars, Twelve Branches, River of Han, and other inner-palace spirit positions — fifty-four in the second niche;

sentences.zh: 二十八宿等中官神位百五十有九於第三龕；

translations.literal: the Twenty-eight Mansions and other central-palace spirit positions — one hundred fifty-nine in the third niche;
translations.idiomatic: the Twenty-eight Mansions and other central-palace spirit positions — one hundred fifty-nine in the third niche;

sentences.zh: 外官神位一百有六於內壝之內；

translations.literal: outer-palace spirit positions — one hundred six within the inner enclosure;
translations.idiomatic: outer-palace spirit positions — one hundred six within the inner enclosure;

sentences.zh: 眾星三百有六十於內壝之外。

translations.literal: the host of stars — three hundred sixty outside the inner enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: the host of stars — three hundred sixty outside the inner enclosure.

sentences.zh: 第一龕席以稿秸，余以莞席，皆內向配位。

translations.literal: The first niche uses straw mats; the rest use rush mats; all associated positions face inward.
translations.idiomatic: The first niche uses straw mats; the rest use rush mats. All associated positions face inward.

sentences.zh: 太祖乾德元年，始有事於南郊。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qiande under Emperor Taizu, the dynasty first undertook the suburban sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Qiande era under Emperor Taizu, the dynasty first undertook the suburban sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 自五代以來，喪亂相繼，典章制度，多所散逸。

translations.literal: Since the Five Dynasties, mourning and disorder had followed one upon another, and canonical regulations and institutions had largely been scattered and lost.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Five Dynasties, mourning and disorder had followed one upon another, and canonical regulations and institutions had largely been scattered and lost.

sentences.zh: 至是，詔有司講求遺逸，遵行典故，以副寅恭之意。

translations.literal: At this time an edict ordered the responsible offices to seek out what had been lost, follow established precedents, and fulfill the intent of reverent respect.
translations.idiomatic: At this time an edict ordered the responsible offices to recover what had been lost, follow established precedents, and fulfill the intent of reverent respect.

sentences.zh: 是歲十一月十六日，合祭天地於圜丘。

translations.literal: On the sixteenth day of the eleventh month of that year, Heaven and Earth were jointly sacrificed to at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixteenth day of the eleventh month of that year, Heaven and Earth were jointly sacrificed to at the Circular Mound.

sentences.zh: 初，有司議配享，請以僖祖升配，張昭獻議曰：「隋、唐以前，雖追立四廟或六七廟，而無遍加帝號之文。

translations.literal: At first the responsible offices deliberated on associated worship and requested that Imperial Ancestor Xizu be elevated as associate. Zhang Zhao submitted his opinion, saying: "Before the Sui and Tang, although four temples or six or seven temples were posthumously established, there was no text of universally adding imperial titles.
translations.idiomatic: At first the responsible offices deliberated on associated worship and requested that Imperial Ancestor Xizu be elevated as associate. Zhang Zhao submitted his opinion, saying: "Before the Sui and Tang, although four temples or six or seven temples were posthumously established, there was no text of universally adding imperial titles.

sentences.zh: 梁、陳南郊，祀天皇，配以皇考；

translations.literal: At the Southern Suburb of Liang and Chen, the Heavenly Sovereign was sacrificed to, with the imperial father as associate;
translations.idiomatic: At the Southern Suburb sacrifices of Liang and Chen, the Heavenly Sovereign was worshipped, with the imperial father as associate;

sentences.zh: 北齊圜丘，祀昊天，以神武升配；

translations.literal: at the Circular Mound of Northern Qi, Haotian was sacrificed to, with Shenwu elevated as associate;
translations.idiomatic: at the Circular Mound of Northern Qi, Haotian was worshipped, with Emperor Shenwu elevated as associate;

sentences.zh: 隋祀昊天於圜丘，以皇考配；

translations.literal: Sui sacrificed to Haotian at the Circular Mound, with the imperial father as associate;
translations.idiomatic: the Sui sacrificed to Haotian at the Circular Mound, with the imperial father as associate;

sentences.zh: 唐貞觀初，以高祖配圜丘；

translations.literal: at the beginning of Zhenguan in Tang, Gaozu was made associate at the Circular Mound;
translations.idiomatic: at the beginning of the Zhenguan era in Tang, Gaozu was made associate at the Circular Mound;

sentences.zh: 梁太祖郊天，以皇考烈祖配。

translations.literal: the Liang founder sacrificed to Heaven in the suburbs, with the imperial father Liezu as associate.
translations.idiomatic: the Liang founder sacrificed to Heaven in the suburbs, with the imperial father Liezu as associate.

sentences.zh: 恭惟宣祖皇帝，積累勳伐，肇基王業，伏請奉以配享。」

translations.literal: Respectfully considering Emperor Xuanzu, who accumulated merit through campaigns and founded the royal enterprise, we respectfully request that he be installed for associated worship."
translations.idiomatic: Respectfully considering Emperor Xuanzu, who accumulated merit through campaigns and founded the royal enterprise, we respectfully request that he be installed for associated worship."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 九年正月，詔以四月幸西京，有事於南郊。

translations.literal: In the first month of the ninth year, an edict ordered that in the fourth month the emperor would visit the Western Capital and perform the suburban sacrifice at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the ninth year, an edict ordered that in the fourth month the emperor would visit the Western Capital and perform the suburban sacrifice at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 自國初以來，南郊四祭及感生帝、皇地祇、神州凡七祭，並以四祖迭配。

translations.literal: From the founding of the dynasty, the four sacrifices at the Southern Suburb together with the Spirit of Life-Generation, Imperial Earth Spirit, and Divine Land — seven sacrifices in all — all used the four ancestors in rotation as associates.
translations.idiomatic: From the founding of the dynasty, the four sacrifices at the Southern Suburb together with the Spirit of Life-Generation, Imperial Earth Spirit, and Divine Land — seven sacrifices in all — had all used the four ancestors in rotation as associated spirits.

sentences.zh: 太祖親郊者四，並以宣祖配。

translations.literal: Taizu personally performed suburban sacrifice four times, all with Xuanzu as associate.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu personally performed suburban sacrifice on four occasions, each time with Xuanzu as the associated spirit.

sentences.zh: 太宗即位，其七祭但以宣祖、太祖更配。

translations.literal: When Taizong ascended the throne, for the seven sacrifices only Xuanzu and Taizu alternated as associates.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong came to the throne, the seven sacrifices used only Xuanzu and Taizu in rotation as associated spirits.

sentences.zh: 是歲親享天地，始奉太祖升侑。

translations.literal: That year, when he personally offered to Heaven and Earth, Taizu was first installed to ascend as assistant at sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: That year, when he personally offered to Heaven and Earth, Taizu was for the first time installed to assist at the sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 雍熙元年冬至親郊，從禮儀使扈蒙之議，復以宣祖配。

translations.literal: At the winter solstice suburban sacrifice in the first year of Yongxi, following the proposal of the Commissioner of Ritual Hu Meng, Xuanzu was again made associate.
translations.idiomatic: At the winter solstice suburban sacrifice in the first year of Yongxi, following the proposal of the Commissioner of Ritual Hu Meng, Xuanzu was again made the associated spirit.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，禮儀使蘇易簡言：「親祀圜丘，以宣祖配，此則符聖人大孝之道，成嚴父配天之儀。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year, the Commissioner of Ritual Su Yijian said: "When personally sacrificing at the Circular Mound, using Xuanzu as associate — this accords with the sages' way of supreme filial piety and completes the ceremony of the revered father as associate to Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year, the Commissioner of Ritual Su Yijian reported: "When personally sacrificing at the Circular Mound with Xuanzu as associate, this accords with the sages' way of supreme filial piety and completes the rite of the revered father associated with Heaven.

sentences.zh: 太祖皇帝光啟丕圖，恭臨大寶，以聖授聖，傳於無窮。

translations.literal: The Taizu Emperor opened the great enterprise, reverently received the great mandate, passed the sage's mandate from sage to sage, and transmitted it without end.
translations.idiomatic: The Taizu Emperor opened the great enterprise, reverently received the imperial mandate, and passed the sage's mandate from sage to sage for endless generations.

sentences.zh: 按唐永徽中，以高祖、太宗同配上帝。

translations.literal: According to the Tang, in the Yonghui era, Gaozu and Taizong were both associates to Shangdi.
translations.idiomatic: According to Tang practice, in the Yonghui era Gaozu and Taizong were both made associates to Shangdi.

sentences.zh: 欲望將來親祀郊丘，奉宣祖、太祖同配；

translations.literal: We wish that in future personal sacrifices at the suburban mounds, Xuanzu and Taizu be installed as joint associates;
translations.idiomatic: We ask that in future personal sacrifices at the suburban mounds, Xuanzu and Taizu be installed together as associated spirits;

sentences.zh: 其常祀祈穀、神州、明堂，以宣祖崇配；

translations.literal: for the regular sacrifices of Grain Prayer, Divine Land, and Bright Hall, use Xuanzu as elevated associate;
translations.idiomatic: for the regular sacrifices of Grain Prayer, Divine Land, and Bright Hall, use Xuanzu as the elevated associate;

sentences.zh: 圜丘、北郊、雩祀，以太祖崇配。」

translations.literal: for the Circular Mound, Northern Suburb, and rain sacrifice, use Taizu as elevated associate."
translations.idiomatic: for the Circular Mound, Northern Suburb, and rain sacrifice, use Taizu as the elevated associate."

sentences.zh: 奏可。

translations.literal: The memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 真宗至道三年十一月，有司言：「冬至圜丘、孟夏雩祀、夏至方丘，請奉太宗配；

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the third year of Zhidao under Zhenzong, the responsible offices reported: "For the Circular Mound at winter solstice, the rain sacrifice in the first month of summer, and the Square Mound at summer solstice, we request that Taizong be installed as associate;
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the third year of Zhidao under Zhenzong, the responsible offices reported: "For the Circular Mound at the winter solstice, the rain sacrifice in the first month of summer, and the Square Mound at the summer solstice, we request that Taizong be installed as the associated spirit;

sentences.zh: 上辛祈谷、季秋明堂，奉太祖配；

translations.literal: for the Grain Prayer on the first xin day and the Bright Hall in the last month of autumn, install Taizu as associate;
translations.idiomatic: for the Grain Prayer on the first xin day and the Bright Hall in the last month of autumn, install Taizu as the associated spirit;

sentences.zh: 上辛祀感生帝、孟冬祭神州地祇，奉宣祖配；

translations.literal: for worship of the Spirit of Life-Generation on the first xin day and sacrifice to the Imperial Earth Spirit of the Divine Land in the first month of winter, install Xuanzu as associate;
translations.idiomatic: for worship of the Spirit of Life-Generation on the first xin day and sacrifice to the Imperial Earth Spirit of the Divine Land in the first month of winter, install Xuanzu as the associated spirit;

sentences.zh: 其親郊，奉太祖、太宗並配。」

translations.literal: for personal suburban sacrifice, install both Taizu and Taizong as associates."
translations.idiomatic: for personal suburban sacrifice, install both Taizu and Taizong as associated spirits."

sentences.zh: 詔可。

translations.literal: The edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: The edict approved.

sentences.zh: 乾興元年，真宗崩，詔禮官定遷郊祀配帝，乃請：「祈穀及祭神州地祇，以太祖配；

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianxing, when Zhenzong died, an edict ordered ritual officials to fix the associated thearchs for transferred suburban sacrifice. They requested: "For Grain Prayer and sacrifice to the Imperial Earth Spirit of the Divine Land, use Taizu as associate;
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qianxing, when Zhenzong died, an edict ordered ritual officials to determine the associated thearchs for transferred suburban sacrifice. They requested: "For Grain Prayer and sacrifice to the Imperial Earth Spirit of the Divine Land, use Taizu as the associated spirit;

sentences.zh: 雩祀及昊天上帝及皇地祇，乙太宗配；

translations.literal: for the rain sacrifice and for Haotian Shangdi and the Imperial Earth Spirit, use Taizong as associate;
translations.idiomatic: for the rain sacrifice and for Haotian Shangdi and the Imperial Earth Spirit, use Taizong as the associated spirit;

sentences.zh: 感生帝，以宣祖配；

translations.literal: for the Spirit of Life-Generation, use Xuanzu as associate;
translations.idiomatic: for the Spirit of Life-Generation, use Xuanzu as the associated spirit;

sentences.zh: 明堂，以真宗配；

translations.literal: for the Bright Hall, use Zhenzong as associate;
translations.idiomatic: for the Bright Hall, use Zhenzong as the associated spirit;

sentences.zh: 親祀郊丘，以太祖、太宗配。」

translations.literal: for personal sacrifice at the suburban mounds, use Taizu and Taizong as associates."
translations.idiomatic: for personal sacrifice at the suburban mounds, use Taizu and Taizong as associated spirits."

sentences.zh: 奏可。

translations.literal: The memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 景祐二年郊，詔以太祖、太宗、真宗三廟萬世不遷。

translations.literal: At the suburban sacrifice in the second year of Jingyou, an edict declared the temples of Taizu, Taizong, and Zhenzong eternally unmoved for ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: At the suburban sacrifice in the second year of Jingyou, an edict declared that the temples of Taizu, Taizong, and Zhenzong would remain unmoved for ten thousand generations.

sentences.zh: 南郊以太祖定配，二宗迭配，親祀皆侑。

translations.literal: At the Southern Suburb, Taizu was the fixed associate; the two emperors rotated as associates; at personal sacrifice all served as assistants.
translations.idiomatic: At the Southern Suburb, Taizu was the fixed associate; Taizong and Zhenzong rotated as associates; at personal sacrifice all served as assistants at the rite.

sentences.zh: 常祀圜丘、皇地祇配以太祖，祈谷、雩祀、神州配乙太宗，感生帝、明堂以宣祖、真宗配如舊。

translations.literal: For regular sacrifices, the Circular Mound and Imperial Earth Spirit used Taizu as associate; Grain Prayer, rain sacrifice, and Divine Land used Taizong as associate; the Spirit of Life-Generation and Bright Hall used Xuanzu and Zhenzong as associates as before.
translations.idiomatic: For regular sacrifices, the Circular Mound and Imperial Earth Spirit used Taizu as associate; Grain Prayer, rain sacrifice, and Divine Land used Taizong as associate; the Spirit of Life-Generation and Bright Hall used Xuanzu and Zhenzong as associates, as before.

sentences.zh: 慶曆元年，判太常寺呂公綽言：「歷代郊祀，配位無側向，真宗示輔臣《封禪圖》曰：'嘗見郊祀昊天上帝，不以正坐，蓋皇地祇次之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qingli, Lü Gongchuo, acting director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, said: "Through the ages at suburban sacrifice, associated positions had no fixed lateral orientation. Zhenzong showed his chief ministers the Fengshan Diagram, saying: 'I once saw that at suburban sacrifice to Haotian Shangdi, he does not sit facing due south, because the Imperial Earth Spirit is ranked second.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qingli, Lü Gongchuo, acting director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, reported: "Through the ages at suburban sacrifice, associated positions had no fixed lateral orientation. Zhenzong once showed his chief ministers the Fengshan Diagram, saying: 'I once observed that at suburban sacrifice to Haotian Shangdi, he does not sit facing due south, because the Imperial Earth Spirit is ranked second.

sentences.zh: 今修登封，上帝宜當子位，太祖、太宗配位，宜比郊祀而斜置之。

translations.literal: Now, as we repair the Mount Tai ascent, Shangdi should occupy the zi position; the associated positions of Taizu and Taizong should be set obliquely, as at suburban sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Now, as we prepare the Mount Tai ascent, Shangdi should occupy the zi position; the associated positions of Taizu and Taizong should be placed obliquely, as at suburban sacrifice.

sentences.zh: '其後，有司不諭先帝以告成報功、酌宜從變之意，每郊儀範，既引祥符側置之文，又載西向北上之禮，臨時擇一，未嘗考定。」

translations.literal: Thereafter, the responsible offices did not grasp the late emperor's intent to report completion and reward merit and adjust suitably to change. In every suburban ritual protocol they both cited the Xiangfu text on oblique placement and recorded the rite of facing west and ascending from the north; at the time of sacrifice they chose one or the other, never having examined and fixed the matter."
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, the responsible offices failed to grasp the late emperor's intent to report completion, reward merit, and adjust suitably to changing circumstances. In every suburban ritual protocol they both cited the Xiangfu text on oblique placement and recorded the rite of facing west and ascending from the north; at the time of sacrifice they chose one or the other, never having examined and fixed the matter."

sentences.zh: 乃詔南郊祖宗之配，並以東方西向為定。

translations.literal: An edict was then issued that for ancestral associates at the Southern Suburb, all should be fixed as on the east side, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: An edict was then issued that for ancestral associates at the Southern Suburb, all positions should be fixed on the east side, facing west.

sentences.zh: 皇祐五年郊，詔自今圜丘，三聖並侑。

translations.literal: At the suburban sacrifice in the fifth year of Huangyou, an edict declared that from this day at the Circular Mound, all three sages would serve as assistants together.
translations.idiomatic: At the suburban sacrifice in the fifth year of Huangyou, an edict declared that from this day forward at the Circular Mound, all three sages would assist at sacrifice together.

sentences.zh: 嘉祐六年，諫官楊畋論水災繇郊廟未順。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Jiayou, the remonstrance official Yang Tian discussed flood disasters as arising from disharmony at the suburban temples.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Jiayou, the remonstrance official Yang Tian argued that flood disasters arose from disharmony at the suburban temples.

sentences.zh: 禮院亦言：「對越天地，神無二主。

translations.literal: The Board of Ritual also stated: "In facing Heaven and Earth, the spirits have no duplicate lord.
translations.idiomatic: The Board of Ritual also reported: "In facing Heaven and Earth, the spirits have no duplicate lord.

sentences.zh: 唐始用三祖同配，後遂罷之。

translations.literal: Tang first used three ancestors as joint associates, then abolished the practice.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang first used three ancestors as joint associates, then abolished the practice.

sentences.zh: 皇祐初，詔三聖並侑，後復迭配，未幾復並侑，以為定制。

translations.literal: At the start of Huangyou, an edict had all three sages serve as assistants together; later rotation as associates was restored; before long joint assistants were restored again, and this was taken as the fixed regulation.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Huangyou, an edict had all three sages assist at sacrifice together; later rotating associates were restored; before long joint assistants were restored again, and this was taken as the fixed regulation.

sentences.zh: 雖出孝思，然頗違經典，當時有司失於講求。」

translations.literal: Though it arose from filial intent, it quite departed from the classics; the responsible offices of that time failed to investigate thoroughly."
translations.idiomatic: Though it arose from filial intent, it departed considerably from the classics; the responsible offices of that time failed to investigate the matter thoroughly."

sentences.zh: 下兩制議，翰林學士王珪等曰：「推尊以享帝，義之至也。

translations.literal: The matter was referred to the two academies for deliberation. Hanlin academician Wang Gui and others said: "Honoring the ancestors to worship the Thearch is the highest of propriety.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was referred to the two academies for deliberation. Hanlin academician Wang Gui and others reported: "Honoring the ancestors in worship of the Thearch is the highest of propriety.

sentences.zh: 然尊尊不可以瀆，故郊無二主。

translations.literal: Yet honor of the honored must not be profaned; therefore at the suburb there is no duplicate lord.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the honored must not be profaned; therefore at the suburb there is no duplicate lord.

sentences.zh: 今三後並侑，欲以致孝也，而適所以瀆乎享帝，非無以寧神也，請如禮官議。」

translations.literal: Now all three late emperors serve as assistants together — intending to extend filial piety, yet this profanes worship of the Thearch and does not quiet the spirits. We ask that it follow the ritual officials' proposal."
translations.idiomatic: Now all three late emperors assist at sacrifice together — intending to extend filial piety, yet this profanes worship of the Thearch and does not quiet the spirits. We ask that the matter follow the ritual officials' proposal."

sentences.zh: 七年正月，詔南郊以太祖定配。

translations.literal: In the first month of the seventh year, an edict declared that at the Southern Suburb, Taizu would be the fixed associate.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the seventh year, an edict declared that at the Southern Suburb, Taizu would be the fixed associate.

sentences.zh: 高宗建炎二年，車駕至揚州，築壇于江都縣之東南。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jianyan under Gaozong, the imperial carriage reached Yangzhou, and an altar was built in the southeast of Jiangdu County.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jianyan under Gaozong, the imperial carriage reached Yangzhou, and an altar was built in the southeast of Jiangdu County.

sentences.zh: 是歲冬至，祀昊天上帝，以太祖配。

translations.literal: That year at the winter solstice, they sacrificed to Haotian Shangdi, with Taizu as associate.
translations.idiomatic: That year at the winter solstice, they sacrificed to Haotian Shangdi, with Taizu as the associated spirit.

sentences.zh: 度宗鹹淳二年，將舉郊祀，時復議以高宗參配。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianchun under Duzong, as a suburban sacrifice was about to be performed, the proposal was again debated to have Gaozong participate as associate.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xianchun under Duzong, as a suburban sacrifice was about to be performed, debate resumed over having Gaozong participate as an associated spirit.

sentences.zh: 吏部侍郎兼中書門下省檢正洪燾等議，以為：「物無二本，事無二初，舜之郊嚳，商之郊契，周郊後稷，皆所以推原其始也。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Personnel and Secretariat Reviewer Hong Tao and others deliberated, holding: "Things have no duplicate root; affairs have no duplicate beginning. Shun's suburban sacrifice to Ku, the Shang's suburban sacrifice to Qi, and Zhou's suburban sacrifice to Houji — all trace back to the origin.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister of Personnel and Secretariat Reviewer Hong Tao and others deliberated, holding: "Things have no duplicate root; affairs have no duplicate beginning. Shun's suburban sacrifice to Ku, the Shang's suburban sacrifice to Qi, and Zhou's suburban sacrifice to Houji all trace back to the origin.

sentences.zh: 禮者，所以別等差，視儀則，遠而尊者配於郊，近而親者配於明堂，明有等也。

translations.literal: Ritual distinguishes ranks and sets standards of ceremony: those far and honored are associated at the suburb; those near and intimate are associated at the Bright Hall — the distinction of rank is clear.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual distinguishes ranks and sets standards of ceremony: those far and honored are associated at the suburb; those near and intimate are associated at the Bright Hall — the distinction of rank is clear.

sentences.zh: 臣等謂宜如紹興故事，奉太宗配，將來明堂遵用先皇帝彝典，以高宗參侑，庶於報本之禮、奉先之孝，為兩盡其至。」

translations.literal: We hold that it should follow the Shaoxing precedent: install Taizong as associate; for future Bright Hall ceremonies follow the late emperor's canonical rite, with Gaozong participating as assistant — thus both the rite of repaying the root and filial service to the ancestors may be fully fulfilled."
translations.idiomatic: We hold that it should follow the Shaoxing precedent: install Taizong as the associated spirit; for future Bright Hall ceremonies follow the late emperor's canonical rite, with Gaozong participating as assistant — thus both the rite of repaying the root and filial service to the ancestors may be fully fulfilled."

sentences.zh: 詔恭依。

translations.literal: An edict respectfully approved.
translations.idiomatic: An edict respectfully approved.

sentences.zh: 儀注。

translations.literal: Ritual Protocols.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual Protocols.

sentences.zh: 乾德元年八月，禮儀使陶穀言：「饗廟、郊天，兩日行禮，從祀官前七日皆合於尚書省受誓戒，自來一日之內受兩處誓戒，有虧虔潔。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Qiande, the Commissioner of Ritual Tao Gu said: "Feasting the temple and sacrificing to Heaven — two days of ceremony. Attendant officials should all receive the oath of purification seven days beforehand at the Ministry of Rites; receiving two oaths in one day has been insufficiently pure and reverent.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the first year of Qiande, the Commissioner of Ritual Tao Gu reported: "Feasting the temple and sacrificing to Heaven are ceremonies on two separate days. Attendant officials should all receive the oath of purification seven days beforehand at the Ministry of Rites; receiving two oaths in a single day has been insufficiently pure and reverent.

sentences.zh: 今擬十一月十六日行郊禮，望依禮文於八日先受從享太廟誓戒，九日別受郊天誓戒，其日請放朝參。」

translations.literal: We now plan the suburban ceremony for the sixteenth day of the eleventh month. It is hoped that, according to ritual texts, on the eighth day attendants first receive the oath for sharing at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, on the ninth day separately receive the oath for sacrificing to Heaven, and on those days court attendance please be suspended."
translations.idiomatic: We now plan the suburban ceremony for the sixteenth day of the eleventh month. We ask that, according to ritual texts, on the eighth day attendants first receive the oath for sharing at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, on the ninth day separately receive the oath for sacrificing to Heaven, and that court attendance be suspended on those days."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 自後百官受誓戒於朝堂，宗室受於太廟。

translations.literal: Thereafter all officials received the oath at the court hall; members of the imperial clan received theirs at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter all officials received the oath at the court hall, while members of the imperial clan received theirs at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 祭之日均用丑時，秋夏以一刻，春冬以七刻，前二日遣官奏告。

translations.literal: On the day of sacrifice all used the chou hour; in autumn and summer one quarter before, in spring and winter seven quarters before; two days prior, officials were dispatched to report the sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On the day of sacrifice all ceremonies used the chou hour — one quarter before in autumn and summer, seven quarters before in spring and winter — and two days prior officials were dispatched to report the sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 配帝之室，儀鸞司設大次、小次及文武侍臣、蕃客之次，太常設樂位、神位、版位等事。

translations.literal: For the chamber of the associated Thearch, the Office of Imperial Insignia set up the great pavilion, small pavilion, and places for civil and military attendant ministers and foreign guests; the Court of Imperial Sacrifices set up music positions, spirit positions, tablet positions, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: For the chamber of the associated Thearch, the Office of Imperial Insignia set up the great pavilion, small pavilion, and places for civil and military attendant ministers and foreign guests; the Court of Imperial Sacrifices set up music positions, spirit positions, tablet positions, and the like.

sentences.zh: 前一日司尊彝帥其屬以法陳祭器於堂東，僕射、禮部尚書視滌濯告潔，禮部尚書、侍郎省牲，光祿卿奉牲，告充、告備，禮部尚書視鼎鑊，禮部侍郎視腥熟之節。

translations.literal: One day prior, the Director of Sacrificial Vessels led his subordinates to arrange sacrificial vessels in the east hall by regulation; the Vice Director and Minister of Rites inspected washing and announced purity; the Minister and Vice Minister of Rites inspected the sacrificial animals; the Director of Imperial Kitchens presented the animals and announced sufficiency and readiness; the Minister of Rites inspected the cauldrons; the Vice Minister of Rites monitored the timing of raw and cooked offerings.
translations.idiomatic: One day prior, the Director of Sacrificial Vessels led his subordinates to arrange sacrificial vessels in the east hall by regulation; the Vice Director and Minister of Rites inspected the washing and announced purity; the Minister and Vice Minister of Rites inspected the sacrificial animals; the Director of Imperial Kitchens presented the animals and announced sufficiency and readiness; the Minister of Rites inspected the cauldrons; and the Vice Minister of Rites monitored the timing of raw and cooked offerings.

sentences.zh: 祭之旦，光祿卿率其屬取籩、豆、簠、簋實之。

translations.literal: At dawn on the day of sacrifice, the Director of Imperial Kitchens led his subordinates to fill the baskets, dou vessels, grain vessels, and meat vessels.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn on the day of sacrifice, the Director of Imperial Kitchens led his subordinates to fill the baskets, dou vessels, grain vessels, and meat vessels.

sentences.zh: 及薦腥，禮部尚書帥其屬薦籩、豆、簠、簋，戶部、兵部、工部尚書薦三牲之腥熟俎。

translations.literal: When presenting raw offerings, the Minister of Rites led his subordinates to present baskets, dou vessels, grain vessels, and meat vessels; the Ministers of Revenue, War, and Works presented the raw and cooked trays of the three sacrificial animals.
translations.idiomatic: When presenting raw offerings, the Minister of Rites led his subordinates to present baskets, dou vessels, grain vessels, and meat vessels; the Ministers of Revenue, War, and Works presented the raw and cooked trays of the three sacrificial animals.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，各徹，而有司受之以出。

translations.literal: When the rites were finished, each withdrew, and the responsible offices received the vessels and removed them.
translations.idiomatic: When the rites were finished, each withdrew, and the responsible offices received the vessels and removed them.

sentences.zh: 晡後，郊社令帥其屬掃除，御史按視之。

translations.literal: After mid-afternoon, the Director of Suburban Sacrifices led his subordinates in sweeping and cleaning; the censor inspected.
translations.idiomatic: After mid-afternoon, the Director of Suburban Sacrifices led his subordinates in sweeping and cleaning, and the censor inspected.

sentences.zh: 奏中嚴外辦以禮部侍郎，請解嚴以禮部郎中。

translations.literal: For reporting strict inner preparation, the Vice Minister of Rites; for requesting release from strict preparation, the Director of Ritual Affairs of the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: The Vice Minister of Rites reported strict inner preparation; the Director of Ritual Affairs of the Ministry of Rites requested release from strict preparation.

sentences.zh: 贊者設亞、終獻位於小次之南，宗室位於其後；

translations.literal: The master of ceremonies set the positions for secondary and final offerings south of the small pavilion, with positions for imperial clansmen behind them;
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremonies set the positions for secondary and final offerings south of the small pavilion, with positions for imperial clansmen behind them;

sentences.zh: 設公卿位於亞、終獻之南，分獻官位於公卿之後，執事者又在其後，俱重行，西向北上。

translations.literal: dukes and ministers' positions were set south of the secondary and final offerings; separate-offering officials behind the dukes and ministers; attendants behind them again — all in double rows, facing west and ascending from the north.
translations.idiomatic: Positions for dukes and ministers were set south of the secondary and final offerings; separate-offering officials behind the dukes and ministers; attendants behind them again — all in double rows, facing west and ascending from the north.

sentences.zh: 其致福也，太牢以牛左肩、臂、臑折九個，少牢以羊左肩七個、犆豕以左肩五個。

translations.literal: For conferring blessing, the grand offering uses nine pieces from the ox's left shoulder, arm, and shank; the lesser offering seven pieces from the sheep's left shoulder; the single pig five pieces from the left shoulder.
translations.idiomatic: For conferring blessing, the grand offering used nine pieces from the ox's left shoulder, arm, and shank; the lesser offering seven pieces from the sheep's left shoulder; the single pig five pieces from the left shoulder.

sentences.zh: 有司攝事、進胙皆如禮。

translations.literal: When officials performed by proxy and presented sacrificial meat, all followed the rites.
translations.idiomatic: When officials performed the ceremony by proxy and presented sacrificial meat, all followed the rites.

sentences.zh: 太尉展視以授使者，再拜稽首。

translations.literal: The Grand Marshal inspected and presented to the envoy; [the envoy] bowed twice and prostrated.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Marshal inspected and presented the offering to the envoy, who bowed twice and prostrated.

sentences.zh: 既享，大宴，號曰飲福，自宰臣而下至應執事及樂工、馭車馬人等，並均給有差，以為定式。

translations.literal: After the offering, a great feast was held, called the Blessing Feast; from the chief minister down through all who should attend and musicians and carriage handlers alike, all received portions with graded differences, established as the fixed form.
translations.idiomatic: After the offering, a great feast was held, called the Blessing Feast; from the chief minister down through all who should attend, musicians, and carriage handlers alike, all received portions in graded amounts, established as the fixed form.

sentences.zh: 是歲十一月日至，皇帝服袞冕，執圭，合祭天地於圜丘，還禦明德門樓，肆赦。

translations.literal: That year at the winter solstice in the eleventh month, the emperor wore the dark robe and invested with the cap of state, held the jade tablet, jointly sacrificed to Heaven and Earth at the Circular Mound, returned and proceeded to Mingde Gate tower, and proclaimed a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: That year at the winter solstice in the eleventh month, the emperor wore the dark robe and cap of state, held the jade tablet, jointly sacrificed to Heaven and Earth at the Circular Mound, returned to Mingde Gate tower, and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 仁宗天聖二年，詔加真宗諡，上謂輔臣曰：「郊祀重事，朕欲就禁中習儀，其令禮官草具以聞。」

translations.literal: In the second year of Tiansheng under Renzong, an edict added posthumous honorifics for Zhenzong. The emperor said to his chief ministers: "Suburban sacrifice is a weighty affair. I wish to practice the rites within the forbidden palace; let the ritual officials draft a plan and report."
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tiansheng under Renzong, an edict added posthumous honorifics for Zhenzong. The emperor said to his chief ministers: "Suburban sacrifice is a weighty affair. I wish to practice the rites within the forbidden palace; let the ritual officials draft a plan and report."

sentences.zh: 先郊三日，奉諡冊寶於太廟。

translations.literal: Three days before the suburban sacrifice, posthumous title tablets were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Three days before the suburban sacrifice, posthumous title tablets were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 次日，薦享玉清昭應、景靈宮，宿太廟。

translations.literal: The next day, offerings were presented at the Jade Purity Hall for Wondrous Response and the Hall of Illustrious Spirits; the emperor lodged at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: The next day, offerings were presented at the Jade Purity Hall for Wondrous Response and the Hall of Illustrious Spirits, and the emperor lodged at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 既享，赴青城，至大次，就更衣壇改服袞冕行事。

translations.literal: After the offering, he proceeded to the Azure City; upon reaching the great pavilion, he changed at the robe-changing altar into the dark robe and cap of state to perform the rites.
translations.idiomatic: After the offering, he proceeded to the Azure City; upon reaching the great pavilion, he changed at the robe-changing altar into the dark robe and cap of state to perform the rites.

sentences.zh: 五年，郊後擇日恭謝，大禮使王曾請節廟樂，帝曰：「三年一享，不敢憚勞也。」

translations.literal: In the fifth year, after the suburban sacrifice a day was chosen for respectful thanksgiving. Grandee of Ceremonies Wang Zeng requested abbreviated temple music. The emperor said: "Once every three years I offer — I dare not shrink from the labor."
