translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, after the suburban sacrifice a day was chosen for respectful thanksgiving. Grandee of Ceremonies Wang Zeng requested abbreviated temple music. The emperor said: "Once every three years I offer — I dare not shrink from the labor."

sentences.zh: 三獻終，增禮生七人，各引本室太祝升殿，徹豆。

translations.literal: When the three offerings were finished, seven additional ritual attendants were added; each led his chamber's chief libationer up the hall to remove the dou vessels.
translations.idiomatic: When the three offerings were finished, seven additional ritual attendants were added; each led his chamber's chief libationer up the hall to remove the dou vessels.

sentences.zh: 三日，又齋長春殿，謝玉清昭應宮。

translations.literal: On the third day, he fasted again at the Changchun Hall and offered thanks at the Jade Purity Hall for Wondrous Response.
translations.idiomatic: On the third day, he fasted again at the Changchun Hall and offered thanks at the Jade Purity Hall for Wondrous Response.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，賀皇太后，比籍田，勞酒儀，略如元會。

translations.literal: When the rites were finished, he congratulated the Empress Dowager; compared to the plowing ceremony labor-reward feast — the rite was much like the New Year's audience.
translations.idiomatic: When the rites were finished, he congratulated the Empress Dowager; the labor-reward feast resembled that of the plowing ceremony and was much like the New Year's audience.

sentences.zh: 其恭謝云：「臣某虔遵舊典，郊祀禮成，中外協心，不勝歡抃。」

translations.literal: The respectful thanksgiving ran: "I, your subject, reverently follow the old canonical rites. The suburban sacrifice is accomplished, and within and without are of one heart — I cannot contain my joy."
translations.idiomatic: The respectful thanksgiving ran: "I, your subject, reverently follow the old canonical rites. The suburban sacrifice is accomplished, and within and without are of one heart — I cannot contain my joy."

sentences.zh: 宣答曰：「皇帝德備孝恭，禮成嚴配，萬國稱頌，歡豫增深。」

translations.literal: The announcement replied: "The emperor's virtue is complete in filial reverence; the rites are accomplished in solemn association. The ten thousand states offer praise; joy deepens."
translations.idiomatic: The announcement replied: "The emperor's virtue is complete in filial reverence; the rites are accomplished in solemn association. The ten thousand states offer praise; joy deepens."

sentences.zh: 帝再拜還內。

translations.literal: The emperor bowed twice and returned within.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor bowed twice and returned within.

sentences.zh: 樞密使以下稱賀，閣門使宣答，樞密副使升殿侍立，百官稱賀。

translations.literal: From the Commissioner of Military Affairs downward came congratulations; the gate commissioner announced the reply; the Vice Commissioner of Military Affairs ascended the hall to attend standing; the hundred officials offered congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: From the Commissioner of Military Affairs downward came congratulations; the gate commissioner announced the reply; the Vice Commissioner of Military Affairs ascended the hall to attend standing; and the hundred officials offered congratulations.

sentences.zh: 酒三行，還內殿，受命婦賀，司賓自殿側幕次引內命婦於殿庭，北向立，尚儀奏：「請皇太后即御坐。」

translations.literal: After three rounds of wine, he returned to the inner hall for the consorts' congratulations. The usher from the side pavilion behind the hall led the inner consorts into the hall courtyard; facing north they stood. The chief of ceremony reported: "We request that the Empress Dowager take her imperial seat."
translations.idiomatic: After three rounds of wine, he returned to the inner hall for the consorts' congratulations. The usher from the side pavilion behind the hall led the inner consorts into the hall courtyard; facing north they stood. The chief of ceremony reported: "We request that the Empress Dowager take her imperial seat."

sentences.zh: 司賓贊：「再拜。」

translations.literal: The usher intoned: "Bow twice."
translations.idiomatic: The usher intoned: "Bow twice."

sentences.zh: 引班首升自西階，稱封號妾某氏等言：「郊祀再舉，福祚鹹均，凡在照臨，不勝忻抃。」

translations.literal: He led the head of the rank up the west stairs. She spoke using her title and name: "The suburban sacrifice has been performed again; blessing is equally shared. All under divine illumination cannot contain their delight."
translations.idiomatic: He led the head of the rank up the west stairs. She spoke using her title and name: "The suburban sacrifice has been performed again; blessing is equally shared. All under divine illumination cannot contain their delight."

sentences.zh: 降，再拜。

translations.literal: She descended and bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: She descended and bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 尚宮承旨，降自東階，稱「皇太后聖旨」，又再拜。

translations.literal: The chief palace attendant, descending the east stairs, announced "By the Empress Dowager's sacred decree"; they bowed twice again.
translations.idiomatic: The chief palace attendant, descending the east stairs, announced "By the Empress Dowager's sacred decree"; they bowed twice again.

sentences.zh: 司賓宣答曰「已成钜禮，歡豫良深。」

translations.literal: The usher announced the reply: "The great rite is accomplished; joy is indeed deep."
translations.idiomatic: The usher announced the reply: "The great rite is accomplished; joy is indeed deep."

sentences.zh: 皆再拜。

translations.literal: All bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: All bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 次外命婦賀，如內命婦儀，退，皆赴別殿賀皇帝，惟不致詞，不宣答。

translations.literal: Next came the congratulations of the outer consorts, following the inner consorts' rite. They withdrew and all proceeded to separate halls to congratulate the emperor — only without spoken phrases and without announced replies.
translations.idiomatic: Next came the congratulations of the outer consorts, following the inner consorts' rite. They withdrew and all proceeded to separate halls to congratulate the emperor — only without spoken phrases and without announced replies.

sentences.zh: 神宗元豐六年十一月二日，帝將親郊，奉仁宗、英宗徽號冊寶於太廟。

translations.literal: On the second day of the eleventh month in the sixth year of Yuanfeng under Shenzong, as the emperor was about to sacrifice in person at the suburb, he presented honorific title tablets for Renzong and Yingzong at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the second day of the eleventh month in the sixth year of Yuanfeng under Shenzong, as the emperor was about to sacrifice in person at the suburb, he presented honorific title tablets for Renzong and Yingzong at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 是日晚，齋於大慶殿。

translations.literal: That evening he fasted at the Hall of Great Celebration.
translations.idiomatic: That evening he fasted at the Hall of Great Celebration.

sentences.zh: 三日，薦享于景靈宮，齋於太廟。

translations.literal: On the third day he offered at the Hall of Illustrious Spirits and fasted at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the third day he offered at the Hall of Illustrious Spirits and fasted at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 四日，朝享七室，齋於南郊之青城。

translations.literal: On the fourth day he held the morning audience at the seven chambers and fasted at the Azure City of the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourth day he held the morning audience at the seven chambers and fasted at the Azure City of the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 五日冬至，祀昊天上帝於圜丘，以太祖配。

translations.literal: On the fifth day, the winter solstice, he sacrificed to Haotian Shangdi at the Circular Mound, with Taizu as associate.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifth day, the winter solstice, he sacrificed to Haotian Shangdi at the Circular Mound, with Taizu as the associated spirit.

sentences.zh: 是日，帝服靴袍，乘輦至大次。

translations.literal: That day the emperor wore boots and robe, and rode the carriage to the great pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: That day the emperor wore boots and robe and rode the carriage to the great pavilion.

sentences.zh: 有司請行禮。

translations.literal: The responsible offices requested that the rites proceed.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible offices requested that the rites proceed.

sentences.zh: 服大裘，被袞冕以出，至壇中壝門外，殿中監進大圭，帝執以入，宮架樂作，至午階下版位，西向立，樂止。

translations.literal: He put on the great fur robe, donned the dark robe and cap of state, and emerged; reaching the gate outside the inner enclosure of the altar, the Director of the Palace brought forward the great jade tablet; the emperor took it and entered. Court ensemble music played until he reached the tablet position below the south stairway, where he stood facing west; the music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: He put on the great fur robe, donned the dark robe and cap of state, and emerged. Reaching the gate outside the inner enclosure of the altar, the Director of the Palace brought forward the great jade tablet; the emperor took it and entered. Court ensemble music played until he reached the tablet position below the south stairway, where he stood facing west; the music stopped.

sentences.zh: 禮儀使贊曰：「有司謹具，請行事。」

translations.literal: The Commissioner of Ritual intoned: "The responsible offices have carefully prepared all. We request that the rites proceed."
translations.idiomatic: The Commissioner of Ritual intoned: "The responsible offices have carefully prepared all. We request that the rites proceed."

sentences.zh: 宮架奏《景安》之樂，文舞作六成，止，帝再拜，詣罍洗，宮架樂作，至洗南北向，樂止。

translations.literal: The court ensemble played the Jing'an music; the civil dancers performed six sequences and stopped. The emperor bowed twice, proceeded to the lustral basin; court music played until he reached the basin facing south; the music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The court ensemble played the Jing'an music; the civil dancers performed six sequences and stopped. The emperor bowed twice and proceeded to the lustral basin; court music played until he reached the basin facing south; the music stopped.

sentences.zh: 帝搢圭，盥帨訖，樂作，至壇下，樂止。

translations.literal: The emperor inserted the jade tablet, finished washing and drying his hands; music played until he reached the foot of the altar; the music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor inserted the jade tablet and finished washing and drying his hands; music played until he reached the foot of the altar; the music stopped.

sentences.zh: 升午階，登歌樂作，至壇上，樂止。

translations.literal: He ascended the south stairway; ascent music played until he reached the top of the altar; the music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: He ascended the south stairway; ascent music played until he reached the top of the altar; the music stopped.

sentences.zh: 殿中監進鎮圭，《嘉安》樂作，詣上帝神坐前，北向跪，奠鎮圭於繅藉，執大圭，俯伏，興，搢圭跪，三上香，奠玉幣，執圭，俯伏，興，再拜。

translations.literal: The Director of the Palace brought forward the suppressing jade tablet; the Jia'an music played. He proceeded before the spirit seat of Shangdi, knelt facing north, placed the suppressing jade tablet on the silk mat, took up the great jade tablet, prostrated himself, rose, inserted the jade tablet and knelt, offered incense three times, presented jade and silk, took the jade tablet, prostrated himself, rose, and bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Palace brought forward the suppressing jade tablet; the Jia'an music played. He proceeded before the spirit seat of Shangdi, knelt facing north, placed the suppressing jade tablet on the silk mat, took up the great jade tablet, prostrated himself, rose, inserted the jade tablet and knelt, offered incense three times, presented jade and silk, took the jade tablet, prostrated himself, rose, and bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 內侍舉鎮圭授殿中監，樂止。

translations.literal: The inner attendant raised the suppressing jade tablet and handed it to the Director of the Palace; the music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The inner attendant raised the suppressing jade tablet and handed it to the Director of the Palace; the music stopped.

sentences.zh: 《廣安》樂作，詣太祖神坐前，東向，奠圭幣如上帝儀。

translations.literal: The Guang'an music played. He proceeded before Taizu's spirit seat, faced east, and presented jade and silk according to the rite for Shangdi.
translations.idiomatic: The Guang'an music played. He proceeded before Taizu's spirit seat, faced east, and presented jade and silk according to the same rite used for Shangdi.

sentences.zh: 登歌樂作，帝降壇，樂止。

translations.literal: Ascent music played. The emperor descended the altar. The music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Ascent music played. The emperor descended the altar, and the music stopped.

sentences.zh: 宮架樂作，還位，西向立，樂止。

translations.literal: Court ensemble music played. He returned to his position and stood facing west. The music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Court ensemble music played. He returned to his position and stood facing west, and the music stopped.

sentences.zh: 禮部尚書、戶部尚書以下奉饌俎，宮架《豐安》樂作，奉奠訖，樂止。

translations.literal: The Ministers of Rites and Revenue and those below presented the food stands. The court ensemble played the Feng'an music. When the presentation was complete, the music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministers of Rites and Revenue and their subordinates presented the food stands; the court ensemble played the Feng'an music. When the presentation was complete, the music stopped.

sentences.zh: 再詣罍洗，帝搢大圭，盥帨，洗爵拭爵訖，執大圭，宮架樂作，至壇下，樂止。

translations.literal: Again he proceeded to the lustral basin. The emperor inserted the great jade tablet, washed and dried his hands, washed and wiped the goblet until finished, and took up the great jade tablet. Court ensemble music played until he reached the foot of the altar. The music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Again he proceeded to the lustral basin. The emperor inserted the great jade tablet, washed and dried his hands, and washed and wiped the goblet until finished. He then took up the great jade tablet; court ensemble music played until he reached the foot of the altar, and the music stopped.

sentences.zh: 升自午階，登歌樂作，至壇上，樂止。

translations.literal: He ascended by the south stairway. Ascent music played until he reached the top of the altar. The music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: He ascended by the south stairway; ascent music played until he reached the top of the altar, and the music stopped.

sentences.zh: 登歌《禧安》樂作，詣上帝神坐前，搢圭跪，執爵祭酒，三奠訖，執圭，俯伏，興，樂止。

translations.literal: The Xian'an ascent music played. He proceeded before Shangdi's spirit seat, inserted the jade tablet and knelt, took the goblet and poured libation wine, presented it three times until finished, took the jade tablet, prostrated himself, rose, and the music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The Xian'an ascent music played. He proceeded before Shangdi's spirit seat, inserted the jade tablet and knelt, took the goblet and poured the libation wine, presenting it three times until finished. He then took the jade tablet, prostrated himself, rose, and the music stopped.

sentences.zh: 太祝讀冊，帝再拜訖，樂作。

translations.literal: The Grand Invoker read the text. The emperor finished bowing twice. Music played.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Invoker read the text. When the emperor had finished bowing twice, music played.

sentences.zh: 次詣太祖神坐前，如前儀。

translations.literal: Next he proceeded before Taizu's spirit seat, according to the previous rite.
translations.idiomatic: Next he proceeded before Taizu's spirit seat, following the same rite as before.

sentences.zh: 登歌樂作，帝降自午階，樂止。

translations.literal: Ascent music played. The emperor descended by the south stairway. The music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Ascent music played. The emperor descended by the south stairway, and the music stopped.

sentences.zh: 宮架樂作，還位，西向立，樂止。

translations.literal: Court ensemble music played. He returned to his position and stood facing west. The music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Court ensemble music played. He returned to his position and stood facing west, and the music stopped.

sentences.zh: 文舞退，武舞進，宮架《正安》之樂作，樂止。

translations.literal: The civil dancers withdrew and the military dancers advanced. The court ensemble played the Zheng'an music. The music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The civil dancers withdrew and the military dancers advanced; the court ensemble played the Zheng'an music, and the music stopped.

sentences.zh: 亞獻盥帨訖，《正安》樂作，禮畢，樂止。

translations.literal: The secondary offering officer finished washing and drying his hands. The Zheng'an music played. The rites were completed. The music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: When the secondary offering officer had finished washing and drying his hands, the Zheng'an music played. When the rites were completed, the music stopped.

sentences.zh: 終獻行禮並如上儀，獻畢，宮架樂作，帝升自午階，樂止。

translations.literal: The final offering was performed according to the same rite above. When the offerings were complete, court ensemble music played. The emperor ascended by the south stairway. The music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The final offering was performed according to the same rite as above. When the offerings were complete, court ensemble music played as the emperor ascended by the south stairway, and the music stopped.

sentences.zh: 登歌樂作，至飲福位，樂止。

translations.literal: Ascent music played until he reached the position for receiving blessing wine. The music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Ascent music played until he reached the position for receiving blessing wine, and the music stopped.

sentences.zh: 《禧安》樂作，帝再拜，搢圭跪，受爵，祭酒三，啐酒，奠爵，受俎，奠俎，受摶黍豆，再受爵，飲福訖，奠爵，執圭，俯伏，興，再拜，樂作。

translations.literal: The Xian'an music played. The emperor bowed twice, inserted the jade tablet and knelt, received the goblet, poured libation wine three times, sipped and returned the wine, placed the goblet, received the stand, placed the stand, received the millet and bean cakes, again received the goblet, finished receiving blessing wine, placed the goblet, took the jade tablet, prostrated himself, rose, bowed twice, and music played.
translations.idiomatic: The Xian'an music played. The emperor bowed twice, inserted the jade tablet and knelt, received the goblet, poured libation wine three times, sipped and returned the wine, and placed the goblet. He received the sacrificial stand and placed it, received the millet and bean cakes, again received the goblet, and finished receiving the blessing wine. He placed the goblet, took the jade tablet, prostrated himself, rose, and bowed twice as music played.

sentences.zh: 帝降，還位如前儀。

translations.literal: The emperor descended and returned to his position according to the previous rite.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor descended and returned to his position as before.

sentences.zh: 禮部、戶部尚書徹俎豆，禮直官曰：「賜胙行事。」

translations.literal: The Ministers of Rites and Revenue removed the stands and vessels. The Ritual Officer said: "Grant sacrificial meat to the officiants."
translations.idiomatic: The Ministers of Rites and Revenue removed the stands and vessels. The Ritual Officer announced: "Grant sacrificial meat to the officiants."

sentences.zh: 陪祀官再拜，宮架《宴安》樂作，一成止。

translations.literal: The associate sacrificers bowed twice. The court ensemble played the Yan'an music, one sequence, and stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The associate sacrificers bowed twice. The court ensemble played one sequence of the Yan'an music and stopped.

sentences.zh: 宮架樂作，帝詣望燎位，南向立，樂止。

translations.literal: Court ensemble music played. The emperor proceeded to the viewing-the-burning position and stood facing south. The music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Court ensemble music played as the emperor proceeded to the viewing-the-burning position and stood facing south; the music stopped.

sentences.zh: 禮直官曰：「可燎。」

translations.literal: The Ritual Officer said: "The burning may proceed."
translations.idiomatic: The Ritual Officer announced: "The burning may proceed."

sentences.zh: 俟火燎半柴，禮儀使跪奏：「禮畢。」

translations.literal: They waited until the fire had burned half the faggots. The Commissioner of Ritual knelt and reported: "The rites are complete."
translations.idiomatic: They waited until the fire had burned half the faggots. The Commissioner of Ritual knelt and reported: "The rites are complete."

sentences.zh: 宮架樂作，帝出中壝門，殿中監受大圭，歸大次，樂止。

translations.literal: Court ensemble music played. The emperor exited the inner enclosure gate. The Director of the Palace received the great jade tablet. He returned to the great pavilion. The music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Court ensemble music played. The emperor exited the inner enclosure gate; the Director of the Palace received the great jade tablet, and he returned to the great pavilion as the music stopped.

sentences.zh: 有司奏解嚴。

translations.literal: The responsible offices reported lifting the restrictions.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible offices reported that restrictions were lifted.

sentences.zh: 帝乘輿還青城，百官稱賀於端誠殿。

translations.literal: The emperor rode the imperial carriage back to the Azure City. All officials offered congratulations at Duanzheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rode the imperial carriage back to the Azure City, and all officials offered congratulations at Duanzheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 有司轉仗衛，奏中嚴外辦。

translations.literal: The responsible offices shifted the guard formations and reported inner vigilance and outer readiness.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible offices shifted the guard formations and reported that inner vigilance and outer readiness had been achieved.

sentences.zh: 帝服通天冠、絳紗袍，乘輿以出。

translations.literal: The emperor wore the Tongtian cap and crimson gauze robe and rode the imperial carriage to depart.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wore the Tongtian cap and crimson gauze robe and rode the imperial carriage out.

sentences.zh: 至玉輅所，侍中跪請降輿升輅。

translations.literal: Reaching the place of the jade carriage, the Palace Attendant knelt and requested that he descend from the carriage and ascend the jade carriage.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching the place of the jade carriage, the Palace Attendant knelt and requested that he descend from the imperial carriage and ascend the jade carriage.

sentences.zh: 帝升輅，門下侍郎奏請進行，又奏請少駐，侍臣乘馬，將至宣德門，奏《采薺》一曲，入門，樂止。

translations.literal: The emperor ascended the jade carriage. The Vice Director of the Chancellery reported requesting to proceed, again reported requesting a brief halt. Attending ministers rode horses. Approaching Xuande Gate, they played one piece of "Gathering Shepherd's Purse." Entering the gate, the music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ascended the jade carriage. The Vice Director of the Chancellery requested permission to proceed and then requested a brief halt. Attending ministers rode on horseback. As they approached Xuande Gate, one piece of "Gathering Shepherd's Purse" was played. Upon entering the gate, the music stopped.

sentences.zh: 侍中請降輅赴幄次，有司奏解嚴。

translations.literal: The Palace Attendant requested that he descend from the carriage and proceed to the tent pavilion. The responsible offices reported lifting the restrictions.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Attendant requested that he descend from the carriage and proceed to the tent pavilion. The responsible offices reported that restrictions were lifted.

sentences.zh: 帝常服，乘輿禦宣德門，肆赦，群臣稱賀如常儀。

translations.literal: The emperor in everyday dress rode the imperial carriage to Xuande Gate, proclaimed a general amnesty, and the assembled ministers offered congratulations according to the usual rite.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor changed into everyday dress, rode the imperial carriage to Xuande Gate, proclaimed a general amnesty, and the assembled ministers offered congratulations according to the usual rite.

sentences.zh: 初，淳化三年，將以冬至郊，前十日，皇子許王薨，有司言：「王薨在未受誓戒之前，准禮，天地、社稷之祀不廢。」

translations.literal: At first, in the third year of Chunhua, when the winter-solstice suburban sacrifice was planned, ten days beforehand Prince Xu died. The responsible offices stated: "The prince died before the oath had been received. According to ritual, sacrifices to Heaven and Earth and the Altars of Soil and Grain are not to be abandoned."
translations.idiomatic: At first, in the third year of the Chunhua era, when a winter-solstice suburban sacrifice was planned, ten days beforehand Prince Xu died. The responsible offices reported: "The prince died before the oath had been received. According to ritual, sacrifices to Heaven and Earth and the Altars of Soil and Grain are not to be abandoned."

sentences.zh: 詔下尚書省議。

translations.literal: An edict was sent down to the Secretariat for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: An edict was sent down to the Secretariat for deliberation.

sentences.zh: 吏部尚書宋琪等奏：「以許王薨謝，去郊禮裁十日，又詔輟十一日以後五日朝參，且至尊成服，百僚皆當入慰。

translations.literal: Minister of the Civil Office Song Qi and others memorialized: "Because of the mourning announcement for Prince Xu, only ten days remain before the suburban rite. An edict has also suspended court attendance for five days after the eleventh day, and the sovereign is putting on mourning garments; all officials should enter to offer condolences.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of the Civil Office Song Qi and others memorialized: "Because of the mourning announcement for Prince Xu, only ten days remain before the suburban rite. An edict has also suspended court attendance for five days after the eleventh day, and the sovereign is putting on mourning garments; all officials should enter to offer condolences.

sentences.zh: 有司又以十二、十三日受誓戒，按令式，受誓戒後不得弔喪問疾。

translations.literal: The responsible offices also note that the oath will be received on the twelfth and thirteenth days. According to the statutes, after receiving the oath one may not attend funerals or inquire after the sick.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible offices also note that the oath will be received on the twelfth and thirteenth days. According to the statutes, after receiving the oath one may not attend funerals or inquire after the sick.

sentences.zh: 今若皇帝既輟朝而未成服，則全爽禮文；

translations.literal: If now the emperor has suspended court but has not yet completed mourning garments, the ritual texts are wholly violated;
translations.idiomatic: If now the emperor has suspended court but has not yet completed mourning garments, the ritual texts are wholly violated;

sentences.zh: 百僚既受誓而入奉慰，又違令式。

translations.literal: if the assembled officials have received the oath and yet enter to offer condolences, they again violate the statutes.
translations.idiomatic: if the assembled officials have received the oath and yet enter to offer condolences, they again violate the statutes.

sentences.zh: 況許王地居藩戚，望著親賢，于昆仲為大宗，於朝廷為塚嗣，遽茲薨逝，朝野同哀，伏想聖情，豈勝追念。

translations.literal: Moreover, Prince Xu stood among the imperial clansmen in rank and was renowned for kinship and worth. Among his brothers he was the eldest heir; in the court he was the heir designate. His sudden death has brought shared grief throughout court and countryside. We can only imagine how deeply Your Majesty must mourn and remember.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, Prince Xu stood among the imperial clansmen in rank and was renowned for kinship and worth. Among his brothers he was the eldest heir; at court he was the heir designate. His sudden death has brought shared grief throughout court and countryside. We can only imagine how deeply Your Majesty must mourn and remember.

sentences.zh: 當愁慘之際，行對越之儀，臣等實慮上帝之弗歆，下民之斯惑。

translations.literal: To perform the ceremony of facing and ascending at a time of such grief — we truly fear that the Supreme Lord will not accept it and the people below will be perplexed.
translations.idiomatic: To perform the ceremony of facing and ascending at a time of such grief — we truly fear that the Supreme Lord will not accept it and the people below will be perplexed.

sentences.zh: 況祭天之禮，歲有四焉，載於《禮經》，非有差降。

translations.literal: Moreover, the rite of sacrificing to Heaven occurs four times a year, as recorded in the Classic of Rites, without any reduction in rank.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the rite of sacrificing to Heaven occurs four times a year, as recorded in the Classic of Rites, without any reduction in precedence.

sentences.zh: 請以來年正月上辛合祭天地。」

translations.literal: We request that Heaven and Earth be jointly sacrificed to on the first xin day of the first month of the coming year."
translations.idiomatic: We request that Heaven and Earth be jointly sacrificed to on the first xin day of the first month of the coming year."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 神宗之嗣位也，英宗之喪未除。

translations.literal: When Shenzong succeeded to the throne, Yingzong's mourning had not yet been completed.
translations.idiomatic: When Shenzong succeeded to the throne, the mourning period for Emperor Yingzong had not yet ended.

sentences.zh: 是歲當郊，帝以為疑，以問講讀官王珪、司馬光、王安石，皆對以不當廢。

translations.literal: That year the suburban sacrifice was due. The emperor was uncertain and questioned the Lecture and Reading officials Wang Gui, Sima Guang, and Wang Anshi. All replied that it should not be abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: That year the suburban sacrifice was due. Unsure what to do, the emperor asked the Lecture and Reading officials Wang Gui, Sima Guang, and Wang Anshi; all replied that the ceremony should not be abandoned.

sentences.zh: 珪又謂：「'喪三年不祭，惟祭天地、社稷，為越紼而行事。

translations.literal: Wang Gui further said: "'During mourning for three years one does not sacrifice, except to Heaven and Earth and the Altars of Soil and Grain, acting by crossing the mourning cord.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Gui further argued: "'During the three-year mourning period one does not perform sacrifices, save only to Heaven and Earth and the Altars of Soil and Grain, acting in a manner that crosses the mourning cord.

sentences.zh: '《傳》謂：'不敢以卑廢尊也。

translations.literal: The Commentary states: 'One dare not let the lesser set aside the greater.
translations.idiomatic: The Commentary explains: 'One must not let lesser obligations cancel out greater ones.

sentences.zh: '景德二年，真宗居明德太后之喪，即易月而服除。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jingde, Zhenzong was in mourning for Empress Dowager Mingde; he changed month and the mourning garments were removed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Jingde era, while Zhenzong was in mourning for Empress Dowager Mingde, he shortened the mourning period and ended it after one month.

sentences.zh: 明年遂享太廟，而合祀天地於圜丘。

translations.literal: The next year he then offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and jointly sacrificed to Heaven and Earth at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he proceeded to offer sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple and jointly sacrificed to Heaven and Earth at the Circular Mound.

sentences.zh: 請冬至行郊廟之禮，其服冕、車輅、儀物、音樂緣神事者皆不可廢。」

translations.literal: I request that the suburban and temple rites be performed at the winter solstice. The cap and robe of state, carriages, ritual objects, and music connected with divine matters all cannot be abandoned."
translations.idiomatic: I therefore request that the suburban and temple rites be carried out at the winter solstice, and that the cap and robe of state, carriages, ritual objects, and music connected with divine matters must not be abandoned."

sentences.zh: 詔用景德故事，惟郊廟及景靈宮禮神用樂，鹵簿鼓吹及樓前宮架、諸軍音樂，皆備而不作，警場止鳴金鉦、鼓角，仍罷諸軍呈閱騎隊。

translations.literal: An edict adopted the Jingde precedent: only at the suburban sacrifice, temple sacrifice, and Jingling Palace divine rites was music used. The guard of honor with drums and pipes, the court ensemble before the tower, and the music of the various armies were all prepared but not performed. The alert grounds only sounded bronze gongs and horn drums, and the cavalry review formations of the various armies were also discontinued.
translations.idiomatic: An edict adopted the Jingde precedent: music was used only for the divine rites at the suburban sacrifice, the temple sacrifice, and Jingling Palace. The guard-of-honor drums and pipes, the court ensemble before the tower, and the music of the various armies were all prepared but not performed. At the alert grounds only bronze gongs and horn drums were sounded, and the various armies' cavalry review formations were cancelled as well.

sentences.zh: 故事，齋宿必禦樓警嚴，幸後苑觀花，作水戲，至是悉罷之。

translations.literal: By precedent, during fasting one always mounted the tower with vigilance and strict guard, visited the rear garden to view flowers, and performed water entertainments. At this time all were discontinued.
translations.idiomatic: By long-standing custom, during the fasting period the emperor would mount the tower with solemn vigilance, visit the rear garden to view flowers, and enjoy water entertainments—but on this occasion all such diversions were discontinued.

sentences.zh: 有司言：「故事，當謁謝於祖宗神禦殿，獻享月吉禮，以禮官攝。」

translations.literal: The responsible offices stated: "By precedent, one should pay reverence and thanks at the Spirit Hall of the ancestral spirits, with the monthly auspicious-day offering performed by ritual officials as proxies."
translations.idiomatic: The responsible offices reported: "By precedent, the emperor should pay reverence and thanks at the Spirit Hall of the ancestral spirits, with the monthly auspicious-day offering performed by ritual officials as proxies."

sentences.zh: 詔遣輔臣仍罷詣佛寺。

translations.literal: An edict dispatched assisting ministers and also discontinued visits to Buddhist temples.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed that assisting ministers be dispatched in his stead and that visits to Buddhist temples be discontinued as well.

sentences.zh: 是後國有故，皆遣輔臣。

translations.literal: After this, whenever the state had an occasion of mourning, assisting ministers were always dispatched.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, whenever the state was in mourning, assisting ministers were dispatched in the emperor's place.

sentences.zh: 高宗紹興十二年，臣僚言：「自南巡以來，三歲之祀，獨於明堂，而郊天之禮未舉，來歲乞行大禮。」

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Shaoxing under Gaozong, officials stated: "Since the southward relocation, the triennial sacrifice has been performed only at the Bright Hall, while the rite of sacrificing to Heaven in the suburbs has not been held. We request that the great rite be performed next year."
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of the Shaoxing era of Emperor Gaozong, officials submitted: "Since the court's relocation south, the triennial sacrifice has been held only at the Bright Hall, while the suburban sacrifice to Heaven has not yet been performed. We request that the great rite be carried out next year."

sentences.zh: 詔建圜壇于臨安府行宮東城之外，自是凡六郊焉。

translations.literal: An edict ordered construction of a Circular Mound altar outside the eastern wall of the temporary palace in Lin'an Prefecture. From then on there were six suburban sacrifices in all.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that a Circular Mound altar be built outside the eastern wall of the temporary palace in Lin'an Prefecture. From that point on, six suburban sacrifices were performed in all.

sentences.zh: 孝宗隆興二年，詔曰：「聯恭覽國史，太祖乾德詔書有云：'務從省約，無至勞煩。

translations.literal: In the second year of Longxing under Xiaozong, an edict stated: "We have respectfully reviewed the national history. In the Qiande edict of Taizu it reads: 'Strive for economy and simplicity; do not go so far as to cause fatigue and trouble.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Longxing era of Emperor Xiaozong, an edict stated: "We have respectfully reviewed the national history. In Taizu's Qiande edict it is written: 'Strive for economy and simplicity; avoid imposing undue fatigue and hardship.

sentences.zh: '仰見事天之誠，愛民之仁，所以垂萬世之統者在是。

translations.literal: Looking up, one sees sincerity toward Heaven and benevolence toward the people. That by which the imperial succession is handed down for ten thousand generations lies in this.
translations.idiomatic: In this one sees the sincerity with which he served Heaven and the benevolence with which he cared for the people—the very principles by which the imperial succession is handed down for ten thousand generations.

sentences.zh: 今歲郊見，可令有司，除禮物、軍賞，其餘並從省約。」

translations.literal: For this year's suburban audience, let the responsible offices, except for ritual gifts and military rewards, reduce everything else to economy and simplicity."
translations.idiomatic: For this year's suburban audience, the responsible offices are directed that, apart from ritual gifts and military rewards, everything else be kept economical and simple."

sentences.zh: 初降詔以十一月行事，以冬至適在晦日，以至道典故，改用獻歲上辛，遂改來年元為乾道。

translations.literal: When the edict was first issued scheduling the rites for the eleventh month, because the winter solstice happened to fall on the last day of the month, following the Zhidao precedent the date was changed to the first xin day of the first month of the offering year. The regnal year of the following year was therefore changed to Qiandao.
translations.idiomatic: When the edict was first issued scheduling the ceremony for the eleventh month, the winter solstice happened to fall on the last day of the month; following the Zhidao precedent, the date was changed to the first xin day of the offering year. The regnal year of the following year was therefore changed to Qiandao.

sentences.zh: 乃以正月一日有事南郊，禮成，進胙于德壽宮，以牛腥體肩三、臂上臑二。

translations.literal: Thereupon on the first day of the first month the southern suburb rites were performed. When the rites were complete, sacrificial meat was presented to De Shou Palace, consisting of three shoulder portions of beef with skin and two upper-arm portions with skin.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon on the first day of the first month the southern suburban sacrifice was performed. When the rites were complete, sacrificial meat was presented to De Shou Palace: three shoulder portions of beef with skin and two upper-arm portions with skin.

sentences.zh: 導駕官自端誠殿簪花從駕至德壽宮上壽，飲福稱賀，陳設儀注，並同上壽禮。

translations.literal: The escort officials, wearing flowers in their caps from Duanzheng Hall, followed the imperial procession to De Shou Palace to offer long-life congratulations. Receiving blessing wine and offering congratulations—the arrangements and protocol were all the same as the long-life rite.
translations.idiomatic: The escort officials, wearing flowers in their caps from Duanzheng Hall, followed the imperial procession to De Shou Palace to offer long-life congratulations. The arrangements for receiving blessing wine and offering congratulations followed the same protocol as the long-life rite.

sentences.zh: 皇帝致詞曰：「皇帝臣某言：享帝合宮，受天純嘏，臣某與百僚不勝大慶，謹上千萬歲壽。」

translations.literal: The emperor delivered an address, saying: "The emperor, your subject so-and-so, declares: having received Heaven's pure blessings at the Bright Hall union sacrifice, your subject so-and-so together with the hundred officials, overcome with great rejoicing, respectfully offer ten thousand years of long life."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor delivered an address, saying: "The emperor, your subject, declares: Having received Heaven's pure blessings at the Bright Hall union sacrifice, your subject together with the hundred officials, overcome with great rejoicing, respectfully offer ten thousand years of long life."

sentences.zh: 自後郊祀、明堂進胙飲福，並如上儀。

translations.literal: Thereafter, presenting sacrificial meat and receiving blessing wine at suburban sacrifice and Bright Hall sacrifice all followed the above rite.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, presenting sacrificial meat and receiving blessing wine at suburban sacrifice and Bright Hall sacrifice all followed the same protocol.

sentences.zh: 光宗紹熙二年十一月郊，以值雨，行禮於望祭殿。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the suburban sacrifice in the second year of Shaoxi under Guangzong, because rain occurred, the rites were performed at the Remote Sacrifice Hall.
translations.idiomatic: During the November suburban sacrifice in the second year of the Shaoxi era of Emperor Guangzong, rain forced the ceremony to be held at the Remote Sacrifice Hall.

sentences.zh: 帝遂感疾。

translations.literal: The emperor then fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor subsequently fell ill.

sentences.zh: 理宗四十一年，一郊而已。

translations.literal: In forty-one years under Lizong, there was only one suburban sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Over Lizong's forty-one-year reign, the suburban sacrifice was performed only once.

sentences.zh: 度宗鹹淳二年，權工部尚書趙汝暨等奏：「今歲大禮，正在先帝大祥之後，臣等竊惟帝王受命，郊見天地，不可緩也。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianchun under Duzong, the Acting Minister of Works Zhao Ruji and others memorialized: "This year's great rite falls just after the grand completion of mourning for the late emperor. We respectfully consider that when an emperor receives the Mandate, the suburban audience with Heaven and Earth cannot be delayed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Xianchun era of Emperor Duzong, the Acting Minister of Works Zhao Ruji and others memorialized: "This year's great ceremony falls just after the grand completion of mourning for the late emperor. We respectfully hold that when an emperor receives the Mandate, the suburban audience with Heaven and Earth cannot be postponed.

sentences.zh: 古者有改元即郊，不用前郊三年為計。

translations.literal: In antiquity there were cases where upon changing the era name one immediately performed the suburban sacrifice, without counting three years from the previous suburban sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity there were cases where a new era name was followed immediately by a suburban sacrifice, without waiting the three years since the previous one.

sentences.zh: 況今適在當郊之歲，既逾大祥之期，圜丘之祀，豈容不舉？」

translations.literal: Moreover, now it happens to be the year when the suburban sacrifice is due. The period of grand mourning has already passed. How can the Circular Mound sacrifice fail to be performed?"
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, this is precisely the year when the suburban sacrifice is due, and the period of grand mourning has already passed. How can the Circular Mound sacrifice be left unperformed?"

sentences.zh: 於是降禮，以十一月十七日款謁南郊，適太史院言：「十六日太陰交蝕。」

translations.literal: Thereupon the rites were scheduled for a reverent visit to the Southern Suburb on the seventeenth day of the eleventh month. Just then the Directorate of Astronomy reported: "On the sixteenth day there will be a lunar eclipse."
translations.idiomatic: The rites were accordingly scheduled for a reverent visit to the Southern Suburb on the seventeenth day of the eleventh month. Just then the Directorate of Astronomy reported: "A lunar eclipse will occur on the sixteenth day."

sentences.zh: 遂改來年正月一日南郊行禮，太常寺言：「皇帝既已從吉，請依儀用樂。

translations.literal: The ceremony was therefore changed to the first day of the first month of the following year for the southern suburb rites. The Court of Imperial Sacrifices stated: "Since the emperor has already completed mourning, we request that music be used according to the protocol.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremony was therefore rescheduled for the first day of the first month of the following year. The Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported: "Since the emperor has already completed mourning, we request that music be used according to the full protocol.

sentences.zh: 其十二月二十九日朝獻景靈宮，三十日朝享太廟，尚在禫制之內，所有迎神、奠幣、酌獻、送神作樂外，其盥洗升降行步等樂，備而不作。」

translations.literal: The court presentation to Jingling Palace on the twenty-ninth day of the twelfth month, and the court offering at the Imperial Ancestral Temple on the thirtieth day, still fall within the period of one-year mourning. Apart from music for welcoming the spirits, presenting silks, pouring libations, and sending off the spirits, the music for washing hands, ascending and descending, and walking—all are prepared but not performed."
translations.idiomatic: The court presentation to Jingling Palace on the twenty-ninth day of the twelfth month and the court offering at the Imperial Ancestral Temple on the thirtieth still fall within the one-year mourning period. Apart from the music for welcoming the spirits, presenting silks, pouring libations, and sending off the spirits, the music for washing hands, ascending and descending, and processional steps should all be prepared but not performed."
